japanese: ペットロスとは、ペットを失った飼い主に起きるショックや怒りなどの反応をいう。
romaji: pettorosu toha, petto o utsu ta kainushi ni oki ru shokku ya ikari nadono hannou woiu.
meaning: "Pet loss" refers to the reactions of shock and anger that occur in owners who have been bereaved of their pets.

japanese: 横向きに寝ると「いびき」をかきにくい？
romaji: yokomuki kini neru to ( ibiki) wokakinikui ？
meaning: Is snoring less likely if you sleep on your side?

japanese: 彼女は毎朝シャワーを浴びるといった。
romaji: kanojo wa maiasa shawaa o abi rutoitta.
meaning: She said that she takes a shower every morning.

japanese: ボイラは湯あかがびっしりついた。
romaji: boira wa yu akagabisshiritsuita.
meaning: The boiler was heavily scaled.

japanese: 寝台車を予約したいのですが。
romaji: shindaisha o yoyaku shitainodesuga.
meaning: I'd like to reserve a sleeping berth.

japanese: 彼女はそのとき日光浴をしていました。
romaji: kanojo hasonotoki nikkouyoku woshiteimashita.
meaning: At that time, she was bathing in the sun.

japanese: 彼女は２階の自分の寝室に上がっていった。
romaji: kanojo wa 2 kai no jibun no shinshitsu ni aga tteitta.
meaning: She went upstairs to her bedroom.

japanese: 浴室を散らかしっぱなしにしないで。
romaji: yokushitsu o chira kashippanashinishinaide.
meaning: Don't leave the bathroom in such a mess.

japanese: 彼女はカップに熱湯を注いだ。
romaji: kanojo wa kappu ni nettou o sosoi da.
meaning: She poured boiling water into the cup.

japanese: 私はいつも早起きするわけではない。
romaji: watashi haitsumo hayaoki suruwakedehanai.
meaning: I don't always get up early.

japanese: ゲームカセットの金属端子が汚れていると、ゲーム機にカセットを差し込んだ時、ゲームが起動しにくくなります。
romaji: geemukasetto no kinzokutanshi ga yogore teiruto, geemu kini kasetto o sashikon da toki, geemu ga kidoushi nikukunarimasu.
meaning: If the metal plate terminal of the game cassette is dirty it may be difficult for the game to start when the cassette is inserted into the game console.

japanese: すぐに諦めて昼寝をするかも知れない。
romaji: suguni akirame te hirune wosurukamo shire nai.
meaning: I may give up soon and just nap instead.

japanese: これは寝かす。
romaji: kore wa nekasu.
meaning: This is to put to sleep, to lay (sth) on its side.

japanese: 彼らは湖で水浴びをした。
romaji: karera wa mizuumi de mizuabi woshita.
meaning: They bathed in the lake.

japanese: 海水浴に行ったんだ。
romaji: kaisuiyoku ni itta nda.
meaning: I went swimming in the ocean.

japanese: スキーをした後、温泉の湯船にゆっくり浸かったら、体の芯まで温まることが出来る。
romaji: sukii woshita nochi, onsen no yubune niyukkuri shin kattara, karada no shin made atatama rukotoga dekiru.
meaning: After skiing, relaxing in a hot spring bath can get one fully warmed up.

japanese: ジャーン。それじゃ春田くん、もう見てもいいわよ。みんなの浴衣、お披露目ねぇ～。
romaji: jaan. soreja haruda kun, mou mite moiiwayo. minnano yukata, o hirome nee ~.
meaning: Ta-dah! Well then, Haruta, it's OK to look now! It's everybody's yukata debut.

japanese: 父は私に車を洗うように言いました。
romaji: chichi wa watashi ni kuruma o arau youni ii mashita.
meaning: Father told me to wash the car.

japanese: 強い乱視はコンタクトレンズのほうが矯正できます。
romaji: tsuyoiranshi wa kontakutorenzu nohouga kyousei dekimasu.
meaning: Contact lenses are more able to correct strong astigmatism.

japanese: 梅雨の晴れ間に洗濯物を干すと気分はもう夏でした。
romaji: tsuyu no harema ni sentakumono o hosu to kibun hamou natsu deshita.
meaning: Drying the washing on a fine day in the rainy season; I felt like it was already summer.

japanese: 次、転職するとしたら、自分の今までの経験を活かせる職につきたい。
romaji: tsugi, tenshoku surutoshitara, jibun no imamade no keiken o ika seru shoku nitsukitai.
meaning: Next time I switch jobs, I need work that will let me make use of the experience I've gained up to now.

japanese: ランドリーには洗剤がありますか。
romaji: randorii niha senzai gaarimasuka.
meaning: Are there any detergents in the laundry?

japanese: このドレスは水洗いができますか。
romaji: kono doresu wa mizuarai gadekimasuka.
meaning: Is this dress washable?

japanese: 最初着る前に洗濯してください。
romaji: saishokirumae ni sentaku shitekudasai.
meaning: Wash before first wearing.

japanese: 干物は私の好みに合わない。
romaji: kanbutsu wa watashi no konomi ni awa nai.
meaning: Dried fish is not to my taste.

japanese: 公園のつつじの世話をする庭師が若干名いる。
romaji: kouen notsutsujino sewa wosuru niwashi ga jakkanmei iru.
meaning: Several gardeners look after the azaleas in the park.

japanese: 想像力は私たちの生活のどの側面にも影響を与える。
romaji: souzouryoku wa watashitachi no seikatsu nodono sokumen nimo eikyou o atae ru.
meaning: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.

japanese: このドクロマークは17世紀後半にイギリスで活動した世界的に有名な海賊キャプテン・キッドにちなんでつけられた。
romaji: kono dokuromaaku wa 17 seikikouhan ni igirisu de katsudou shita sekaiteki ni yuumei na kaizoku kyaputen・kiddo nichinandetsukerareta.
meaning: This skull and crossbones was named based on the world-famous Captain Kidd who was active in late 17th century Britain.

japanese: 明日から梅雨前線が活発になります。
romaji: ashita kara baiuzensen ga kappatsu ninarimasu.
meaning: The seasonal rain front is moving in tomorrow.

japanese: 「おしっこしたい」「ジョニー、そうじゃないだろ。『すみません。お手洗いにいきたいんですが』と言いなさい」
romaji: ( oshikkoshitai) ( jonii, soujanaidaro. ( sumimasen. o tearai niikitaindesuga) to ii nasai)
meaning: "I have to pee." "Jonny, that's not the right thing to say. Say, 'Excuse me. I need to go to the toilet.'"

japanese: 洗面所の栓を抜くと、水がガバガバ流れ出した。
romaji: senmenjo no sen o nuku to, mizu ga gabagaba nagaredashi ta.
meaning: When I unplugged the bathroom sink, the water gushed down the drain.

japanese: 食生活は生存に必要である。
romaji: shokuseikatsu wa seizon ni hitsuyou dearu.
meaning: Food is necessary for life.

japanese: 不景気な夏の期間が過ぎると、商売は活気づいた。
romaji: fukeiki na natsu no kikan ga sugi ruto, shoubai wa kakki zuita.
meaning: After a slow summer season, business began to pick up.

japanese: 項目が増えたり減ったりする表示なら、Accessでなくて表計算ソフトを活用すべきだと思います。
romaji: koumoku ga fue tari hetsu tarisuru hyouji nara, Access denakute hyoukeisan sofuto o katsuyou subekidato omoi masu.
meaning: For a display where the data items increase and decrease I think you are best making use of a spreadsheet program, not Access.

japanese: 僕のことに干渉しないでくれ。
romaji: boku nokotoni kanshou shinaidekure.
meaning: Don't interfere in my affairs.

japanese: 日本では昼間でも夜でもタクシーを拾うことができる。
romaji: nippon deha hiruma demo yoru demo takushii o hirou kotogadekiru.
meaning: In Japan you can always catch a cab, day or night.

japanese: ここにゴミ捨てるべからず。
romaji: kokoni gomi sute rubekarazu.
meaning: No dumping rubbish here!

japanese: 燃えるゴミと燃えないゴミの区別もよく分からないよね。
romaji: moe ru gomi to moe nai gomi no kubetsu moyoku waka ranaiyone.
meaning: It's difficult to tell which is which for burnable and non-burnable rubbish as well, isn't it?

japanese: 老人はラバに砂のいっぱい入った袋をのせた。
romaji: roujin wa raba ni suna noippai itsutsu ta fukuro wonoseta.
meaning: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.

japanese: これは拾得物。
romaji: kore wa shuutokubutsu.
meaning: This is found article.

japanese: これは拾万円。
romaji: kore wa juuman'en.
meaning: This is 100.000 Yen.

japanese: 燃料の節約がこの自動車の大きな特長だ。
romaji: nenryou no setsuyaku gakono jidousha no ooki na tokuchou da.
meaning: Fuel economy is a big advantage of this car.

japanese: 紙袋をいただけますか。
romaji: kamibukuro woitadakemasuka.
meaning: Can I have a paper bag?

japanese: 母は、母自身で作った手袋をくれました。
romaji: haha ha, hahajishin de tsukutsu ta tebukuro wokuremashita.
meaning: My mother gave me a pair of gloves of her own making.

japanese: これは曜。
romaji: kore wa you.
meaning: This is weekday.

japanese: 大恋愛の末に結ばれるわけではないから、アバタもエクボということはありえなかった。
romaji: dairen'ai no matsu ni musuba reruwakedehanaikara, abata mo ekubo toiukotohaarienakatta.
meaning: Since they didn't tie the knot following a grand love affair, it wasn't a matter of blind love.

japanese: 彼は昨シーズンで野球をやめました。
romaji: karehasaku shiizun de yakyuu woyamemashita.
meaning: He stopped playing baseball last season.

japanese: これは翌。
romaji: kore wa yoku.
meaning: This is the following, next.

japanese: 良い週末を。
romaji: yoishuumatsu wo.
meaning: Have a nice weekend!

japanese: ただし、学生の本分は学業ですから、期末テストをおろそかにしたらメッ！ですよ？
romaji: tadashi, gakusei no honbun wa gakugyou desukara, kimatsu tesuto woorosokanishitara metsu! desuyo ？
meaning: However, the duty of a student is to study. So if you neglect the end of term test, that's a "no!".

japanese: 物語は結末に近づいた。
romaji: monogatari wa ketsumatsu ni chikazu ita.
meaning: The story drew to a conclusion.

japanese: どーお？童貞卒業した翌朝は気分爽快？
romaji: dooo ？ douteisotsugyou shita yokuchou wa kibunsoukai ？
meaning: So? Feeling refreshed, the morning after graduating from virginity?

japanese: 昨年ロンドンへ行きました。
romaji: sakunen rondon e iki mashita.
meaning: We went to London last year.

japanese: ６月末に参加者を募ったら１週間弱で約５００席が予約でいっぱいになった。
romaji: 6 getsumatsu ni sankasha o tsunotsu tara 1 shuukanjaku de yaku 5 0 0 seki ga yoyaku deippaininatta.
meaning: When participants were sought at the end of June all, about 500, seats were reserved in under a week.

japanese: 両親は、末っ子をえこひいきするかもしれない。
romaji: ryoushin ha, matsu tsu ko woekohiikisurukamoshirenai.
meaning: Parents may favor the youngest child in the family.

japanese: 着物に足袋は欠かせません。
romaji: kimono ni tabi wa kaka semasen.
meaning: In a kimono, tabi can't be absent.

japanese: これは風袋。
romaji: kore wa fuutai.
meaning: This is packing, wrapping, tare.

japanese: 彼女は、一昨年よりもはるかに暮らし向きがよい。
romaji: kanojo ha, issakunen yorimoharukani kurashimuki gayoi.
meaning: She's far better off than she was the year before last.

japanese: 休暇の計画を予め立てている。
romaji: kyuuka no keikaku o arakajimetate teiru.
meaning: We are making advance plans for our holidays.

japanese: 金利は、債務者が負担する事業リスクに応じて定まるものと存じます。
romaji: kinri ha, saimusha ga futan suru jigyou risuku ni ouji te sadama rumonoto zonji masu.
meaning: I know that interest rates are fixed in accordance to the borrower's business risk.

japanese: PC内部のタイマー用ボタン電池が切れた。
romaji: PC naibu no taimaa you botan denchi ga kire ta.
meaning: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.

japanese: 「あの音で考え事ができないわ」と、彼女はタイプライターを見つめながら言った。
romaji: ( ano oto de kangaekoto gadekinaiwa) to, kanojo wa taipuraitaa o mitsu menagara itta.
meaning: "I can't think with that noise," she said, as she stared at the typewriter.

japanese: きみにちょっとしたものをもってきたよ。
romaji: kiminichottoshitamonowomottekitayo.
meaning: I brought you a little something.

japanese: 金利は、債務者が負担する事業リスクに応じて定まるものと存じます。
romaji: kinri ha, saimusha ga futan suru jigyou risuku ni ouji te sadama rumonoto zonji masu.
meaning: I know that interest rates are fixed in accordance to the borrower's business risk.

japanese: 先行詞がthis,that,these,thoseの場合はwhichを用いるのが普通です。
romaji: senkoushi ga this, that, these, those no baai wa which o mochii runoga futsuu desu.
meaning: When the antecedent is this, that, these or those it is usual to use 'which'.

japanese: 人生とは、他の予定を立てることに忙しくしている時に起こる現象のことだ。
romaji: jinsei toha, hokanoyotei o tate rukotoni isogashiku shiteiru tokinioko ru genshou nokotoda.
meaning: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.

japanese: 毎朝必ず天気予報を見てから外出します。
romaji: maiasakanarazutenkiyohou o mite kara gaishutsu shimasu.
meaning: I always watch the weather report before going out in the morning.

japanese: 父は、定年までに約３０年働くことになる。
romaji: chichi ha, teinen madeni yaku 3 0 nenhataraku kotoninaru.
meaning: By the time he retires, my father will have worked for almost thirty years.

japanese: 太陽熱は日本では発電より太陽熱温水器として利用されています。
romaji: taiyounetsu wa nippon deha hatsuden yori taiyounetsuonsuiki toshite riyou sareteimasu.
meaning: In Japan solar heat is used more for solar water heaters than for electricity generation.

japanese: 父は用事で年２回シドニーへ行く。
romaji: chichi wa youji de nen 2 kai shidonii e iku.
meaning: My father goes to Sydney twice a year on business.

japanese: 偏頭痛がおこったときに対処するだけではなく、普段の生活のなかで、偏頭痛をなるべく防いでいくのも大事なことです。
romaji: henzutsuu gaokottatokini taisho surudakedehanaku, fudan no seikatsu nonakade, henzutsuu wonarubeku fusei deikunomo daiji nakotodesu.
meaning: It's the prevention of migraines during daily life that's important, not dealing with migraines when they occur.

japanese: そんなことは起きないでしょう。
romaji: sonnakotoha oki naideshou.
meaning: That won't happen.

japanese: 私は寝なければなりません。
romaji: watashi wa nena kerebanarimasen.
meaning: I have to go to bed.

japanese: 放射線を大量に浴びたら、すぐに嘔吐と下痢が始まります。
romaji: houshasen o tairyou ni abi tara, suguni outo to geri ga hajimari masu.
meaning: After being exposed to a large amount of radiation, vomiting and diarrhea will start quickly.

japanese: 洗ったあと引っ張って形にして。
romaji: aratsu taato hippatsu te katachi nishite.
meaning: Pull into shape after washing.

japanese: 梅雨の晴れ間に洗濯物を干すと気分はもう夏でした。

japanese: これは活 (2)。
romaji: kore wa ikiruikasuikeru katsu.
meaning: This is lively, resuscitation, being helped, living.

japanese: 「危ないですから、俺が拾いますよ」「大丈夫だから・・・いたっ！」「ほら、いわんこっちゃない」
romaji: ( abunai desukara, ore ga hiroi masuyo) ( daijoubu dakara ・・・ itatsu!) ( hora, iwankotchanai)
meaning: "That's dangerous, I'll clear it up." "It's OK ... Ouch!" "Look, didn't I tell you so?"

japanese: なぁ、金は無いかもしれないけどまだプライドは捨てちゃいないんだ。
romaji: naa, kin wa nai kamoshirenaikedomada puraido wa sute chainainda.
meaning: Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.

japanese: 燃えるゴミと燃えないゴミの区別もよく分からないよね。
romaji: moe ru gomi to moe nai gomi no kubetsu moyoku waka ranaiyone.
meaning: It's difficult to tell which is which for burnable and non-burnable rubbish as well, isn't it?

japanese: これは好事家。
romaji: kore wa kouzuka.
meaning: This is dilettante, person of fantastic taste.

japanese: そのうちの２、３羽が巣から押し出され、さらにベランダからも落ちてしまった。
romaji: sonouchino 2, 3 hane ga su kara oshidasa re, sarani beranda karamo ochi teshimatta.
meaning: Of those 2 or 3 were pushed out of the nest, and then fell down from the balcony as well.

japanese: 洗ったあと引っ張って形にして。
romaji: aratsu taato hippatsu te katachi nishite.
meaning: Pull into shape after washing.

japanese: 人は食事を取らなければ死んでしまう。
romaji: nin wa shokuji o tora nakereba shin deshimau.
meaning: If you don't eat, you die.

japanese: 彼は跡形もなく姿を消してしまったんだ。
romaji: karehaatokata monaku sugata o keshi teshimattanda.
meaning: He disappeared without a trace.

japanese: シャッターを押すだけで、最新のテクノロジーがキレイな一枚に仕上げます。
romaji: shattaa o osu dakede, saishin no tekunorojii ga kirei na ichimai ni shiage masu.
meaning: Just press the button and a clear photo will be produced by the latest technology.

japanese: あんな本みたらフツーの女は引くもんな！
romaji: anna hon mitara futsuu no onna wa hiku monna!
meaning: Obviously a normal woman would lose interest if she saw a book like that!

japanese: 年を取ると目ざとくなる。
romaji: nen o toru to mezatoku naru.
meaning: As one grows old, one becomes a light sleeper.

japanese: 彼は嫌な思い出が消えることを願っている。
romaji: karehaiyanaomoide ga kie rukotowo negatsu teiru.
meaning: He wishes to erase bad memories.

japanese: 人のいない部屋の照明をこまめに消す。
romaji: nin noinai heya no shoumei wokomameni kesu.
meaning: Take care to turn off lights in rooms when nobody's in them.

japanese: これは押印。
romaji: kore wa ouin.
meaning: This is affixing one's seal.

japanese: 歯を食い縛る、喉元までせりあがった感情を強引に飲み込む。
romaji: hawokuishibaru, nodomoto madeseriagatta kanjou o gouin ni nomikomu.
meaning: He grits his teeth and forces back his growing fear.

japanese: 彼女は金融市場の取材を担当している。
romaji: kanojo wa kinyuushijou no shuzai o tantou shiteiru.
meaning: She covers Wall Street.

japanese: 消防車はほかの乗り物に優先する。
romaji: shoubousha hahokano norimono ni yuusen suru.
meaning: Fire engines have priority over other vehicles.

japanese: これは引火。
romaji: kore wa inka.
meaning: This is catching fire.

japanese: 彼のいいところを引き出すようにしなさい。
romaji: kano iitokorowo hikidasu younishinasai.
meaning: Try to bring out the best in him.

japanese: 引用した問題ではありませんが、関係代名詞と関係副詞の使い分けを問う問題がリーディングセクションにはあります。
romaji: inyou shita mondai dehaarimasenga, kankeidaimeishi to kankeifukushi no tsukaiwake o toumondai ga riidingusekushon nihaarimasu.
meaning: The problem quoted isn't one, but there are problems in the reading section that ask you to distinguish relative pronouns from relative adverbs.

japanese: 彼は大将に命令を取り消すように頼んだ。
romaji: karehataishou ni meirei o torikesu youni tanon da.
meaning: He asked the general to take back his order.

japanese: 食物は胃の中で消化される。

romaji: kauntaa no atai ga shitei no ( kiri ban) ninattara kinen messeeji o hyoujisa semasu.
meaning: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.

japanese: 商売の取引を日を追って記録している。
romaji: shoubai no torihiki o nichi o otsu te kiroku shiteiru.
meaning: I keep a daily record of my business dealings.

japanese: 録音が終わったらそれを再生して聞かせてください。
romaji: rokuon ga owa ttarasorewo saisei shite kika setekudasai.
meaning: Please play it back for me after you've finished the recording.

japanese: 彼女がその賞を受賞したのは少しも不思議ではない。
romaji: kanojo gasono shou o jushou shitanoha sukoshi mo fushigi dehanai.
meaning: It is no wonder that she was given the prize.

japanese: 彼は賞金を銀行に預金した。
romaji: karehashoukin o ginkou ni yokin shita.
meaning: He deposited the prize money in the bank.

japanese: 彼は１秒のほんの何分の１かでそれをした。
romaji: kareha 1 byou nohonno nanpun no 1 kadesorewoshita.
meaning: He did it in only a fraction of a second.

japanese: 彼はトロフィーを高々と差し上げた。
romaji: kareha torofii o takadaka to sashiage ta.
meaning: He held the trophy up high.

japanese: 情報検索の効率を測る尺度として、再現率と適合率というものがある。
romaji: jouhoukensaku no kouritsu o hakarushakudo toshite, saigenritsu to tekigouritsu toiumonogaaru.
meaning: As yardsticks to measure the effectiveness of information retrieval there exist those called 'recall ratio' and 'precision ratio'.

japanese: 順を追って基本的なタグを覚えていこう。
romaji: jun o otsu te kihonteki na tagu o oboe teikou.
meaning: Let's learn the basic tags in order.

japanese: ほお紅や口紅を差すだけで表情や笑顔がどんどん変わってくるんです。
romaji: hoo kurenai ya kuchibeni o sasu dakede hyoujou ya egao gadondon kawa ttekurundesu.
meaning: Expressions and smiles change like that just from applying rouge and lipstick.

japanese: これは測る auch 計る。
romaji: kore wa hakaru.
meaning: This is to measure, to weigh, to survey, to time (sound, gauge, estimate), to conjecture, to infer, to surmise.

japanese: ついに彼らは用心しながら秒読みを開始した。
romaji: tsuini karera wa youjin shinagara byouyomi o kaishi shita.
meaning: At last, they began to count down cautiously.

japanese: これは毎秒。
romaji: kore wa maibyou.
meaning: This is every second.

japanese: 時差ボケで辛い。
romaji: jisaboke de tsurai.
meaning: I've got a bad case of jet lag.

japanese: 年齢による差別は法律違反であり、退職が強制されるのは、ほんの少数の職業においてである。
romaji: nenrei niyoru sabetsu wa houritsuihan deari, taishoku ga kyousei sarerunoha, honno shousuu no shokugyou nioitedearu.

japanese: 別の局面では、新しい時代への予測が見られた。
romaji: betsunokyokumen deha, atarashiijidai heno yosoku ga mira reta.
meaning: On another plan there was the prediction of a new age.

japanese: 暖房と同様に、冷房時の消費電力量を測定し、旧型と省エネ型（２００１年製）のエアコンを比較しました。

japanese: 誰も事件の順序を思い出すことができなかった。
romaji: daremojiken no junjo o omoidasu kotogadekinakatta.

japanese: 早朝の受付でクジを引いて順番を決めた。

japanese: 光は秒速186,000マイルで進む。
romaji: hikari wa byousoku 186, 000 mairu de susumu.

japanese: これは測量。

japanese: これは不順。

japanese: 諸神は悪を雷で打つという。

japanese: 猫に石を投げるな。

romaji: dakyuu ga in ka auto kawo hantei surunoha muzukashii kotoga ooi.

japanese: これは強打。

japanese: 満点を取るつもりだ。

japanese: これは打点。
romaji: kore wa daten.

romaji: yakyuubu no maneejaa wa 3 nin desu.

japanese: これは同点。

japanese: 彼女は英語の点数がよい。

japanese: 牧師さんは素晴らしい説教でわたしたちを感動させた。

japanese: 盆栽は風情がある。

japanese: 彼はその詩の感想を述べた。
romaji: kareha sono shi no kansou o nobe ta.

japanese: 美しいものについて考えるとき、私は見つめて感心すること以外には自分には何もすることがないということがわかったのだ。

japanese: その時、二人の間に師弟を越えた友情のようなものが芽生えた事は言うまでもない。

meaning: It goes without saying that at that time a kind of friendship beyond master and disciple grew between the two of them.

japanese: ただ、調子を合わせているんじゃない。本当に、私の気持ちを分かっていて同情している目だった。
romaji: tada, choushi o awa seteirunjanai. hontou ni, watashi no kimochi o waka tteite doujou shiteiru meda tta.
meaning: He wasn't just humouring me. Those were the eyes of someone who really understood my feelings and sympathised.

japanese: 日本のクリスマスは、どちらかというと恋人たちの日です。
romaji: nippon no kurisumasu ha, dochirakatoiuto koibito tachino nichi desu.

romaji: kanojo no hanashi wa watashi no ryoushin no omoide o yobimodoshi tekureru.
meaning: Her story brings back memories of my parents.

japanese: 僕が最後に自分の考えを伝えた人は、僕を気違いだと思ったようだ。

romaji: heishi wa kutsuu deumeita.
meaning: The soldier groaned with pain.

japanese: 彼女は支配人にサービスが悪いと苦情を言った。
romaji: kanojo wa shihainin ni saabisu ga warui to kujou o itta.
meaning: She complained to the manager about the service.

japanese: 彼は困難な事態に対処することが出来ない。
romaji: karehakonnan na jitai ni taisho surukotoga dekina i.
meaning: He can't cope with difficult situations.

japanese: これは難所。
romaji: kore wa nansho.
meaning: This is perilous pass (on a route or journey), rough spot.

japanese: アリさん、今日もご苦労さんだよ。はい、角砂糖あげるよ。
romaji: ari san, kyou mogo kurou sandayo. hai, kakuzatou ageruyo.
meaning: Hi Mr Ant, keeping up the good work today as well. Here's a sugar cube.

japanese: 苦心の甲斐があった。
romaji: kushin no kai gaatta.
meaning: That was well worth the trouble.

japanese: 彼女は難問をうまく処理するだろう。
romaji: kanojo wa nanmon woumaku shori surudarou.
meaning: She will cope with difficult problems.

japanese: あははは、ほんっと、隠し事するのが苦手なんだね～。
romaji: ahahaha, hontto, kakushigoto surunoga nigate nandane ~.
meaning: A-hahaha, you really are bad at keeping secrets.

japanese: ペットロスとは、ペットを失った飼い主に起きるショックや怒りなどの反応をいう。
romaji: pettorosu toha, petto o utsu ta kainushi ni oki ru shokku ya ikari nadono hannou woiu.
meaning: "Pet loss" refers to the reactions of shock and anger that occur in owners who have been bereaved of their pets.

japanese: 起きた時私は悲しかった。
romaji: oki ta tokiwatashi wa kanashika tta.
meaning: When I woke up, I was sad.

japanese: でもほんとに、エピソード21には涙が出るほど笑ったよ。
romaji: demohontoni, episoodo 21 niha namida ga deru hodo waratsu tayo.
meaning: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.

japanese: 彼がそれを聞いたら喜ぶよ。
romaji: kare gasorewo kii tara yorokobu yo.
meaning: He would be glad to hear that.

japanese: 万一彼が君の結婚のことを聞こうものなら、彼はものすごく怒るだろう。
romaji: man'ichikare ga kun no kekkon nokotowo kiko umononara, kareha monosugoku ikaru darou.
meaning: Should he hear of your marriage, he will be furious.

japanese: ペットロスとは、ペットを失った飼い主に起きるショックや怒りなどの反応をいう。
romaji: pettorosu toha, petto o utsu ta kainushi ni oki ru shokku ya ikari nadono hannou woiu.
meaning: "Pet loss" refers to the reactions of shock and anger that occur in owners who have been bereaved of their pets.

japanese: 誰かが亡くなったときは悲しいものだよ。
romaji: dareka ga naku nattatokiha kanashii monodayo.
meaning: It's a pity when somebody dies.

japanese: 悲しむことなんてないでしょう。
romaji: kanashi mukotonantenaideshou.
meaning: Why should you be sad?

japanese: な、なにか笑うところありました？あすか、ギャグってました？
romaji: na, nanika warau tokoroarimashita ？ asuka, gyagu ttemashita ？
meaning: Did I say something funny? Did I make a joke?

japanese: これは笑む。
romaji: kore wa emu.
meaning: This is to smile.

japanese: 彼がそれを聞いたら喜ぶよ。
romaji: kare gasorewo kii tara yorokobu yo.
meaning: He would be glad to hear that.

japanese: 恋の苦悩は他のあらゆる喜びよりも遥かに甘美である。
romaji: koi no kunou wa hokano arayuru yorokobi yorimo haruka ni kanbi dearu.
meaning: Pains of love be sweeter far / Than all other pleasures are.

japanese: 彼女は彼の裏切りに激怒した。
romaji: kanojo wa kanouragiri ni gekido shita.
meaning: She boiled over with rage at his betrayal.

japanese: どこからどう見ても薄幸の美少女、悲劇のヒロインだ。
romaji: dokokaradou mite mo hakkou no bishoujo, higeki no hiroin da.
meaning: No matter how you look at it you're a beautiful, ill-fated woman, the heroine of a tragedy.

japanese: 彼女は悲観する傾向がある。
romaji: kanojo wa hikan suru keikou gaaru.
meaning: She has a tendency to look on the dark side of things.

japanese: 頷いたり、手を叩いたり、ほほえんだり、また、爆笑したりして承認を伝える。
romaji: unazui tari, te o tatai tari, hohoendari, mata, bakushou shitarishite shounin o tsutae ru.
meaning: People communicate approval by nodding, by clapping their hands, by smiling or laughing.

japanese: 喜怒哀楽を見せるな。
romaji: kidoairaku o mise runa.
meaning: Don't let your feelings show.

japanese: これは悲恋。
romaji: kore wa hiren.
meaning: This is blighted love, disappointed love.

japanese: 彼らは大笑いした。
romaji: karera wa oowarai shita.
meaning: They howled with laughter.

japanese: ほお紅や口紅を差すだけで表情や笑顔がどんどん変わってくるんです。
romaji: hoo kurenai ya kuchibeni o sasu dakede hyoujou ya egao gadondon kawa ttekurundesu.
meaning: Expressions and smiles change like that just from applying rouge and lipstick.

japanese: 子供の明るい笑い声が森の中に広がった。
romaji: kodomo no akaruiwaraikoe ga mori no nakanihiroga tta.
meaning: The children's laughs spread throughout the forest.

japanese: これだけで厄介払いできたら安いもので、みな大喜びした。
romaji: koredakede yakkaiharai dekitara yasui monode, mina ooyorokobi shita.
meaning: We were all pleased to be so cheaply quit of him.

japanese: いくつサンドイッチ残ってるの？
romaji: ikutsu sandoitchi nokotsu teruno ？
meaning: How many sandwiches are there left?

japanese: 明日私が論文を提出するのを忘れないように、念を押してください。
romaji: ashitawatashi ga ronbun o teishutsu surunowo wasure naiyouni, nen o oshi tekudasai.
meaning: Please remind me to turn in the paper tomorrow.

japanese: お願いだから泣かないで。
romaji: o negai dakara naka naide.
meaning: Please don't cry.

japanese: でもほんとに、エピソード21には涙が出るほど笑ったよ。
romaji: demohontoni, episoodo 21 niha namida ga deru hodo waratsu tayo.
meaning: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.

japanese: その液から溶剤を揮発させる。残るのは、香り成分と植物ワックスの塊。
romaji: sono eki kara youzai o kihatsu saseru. nokoru noha, kaoriseibun to shokubutsu wakkusu no kai.
meaning: Vaporise the solvent from the liquid. What's left is the perfume component and a lump of vegetable wax.

japanese: やり残すことがないように頑張るぞ。
romaji: yari nokosu kotoganaiyouni ganbaru zo.
meaning: I'll do my best to have nothing left to do!

japanese: さぁ笑って、泣くのは後！
romaji: saa waratsu te, naku noha nochi!
meaning: Smile now, cry later!

japanese: これは残留。
romaji: kore wa zanryuu.
meaning: This is residual, residue, stay behind, stay back.

japanese: これは残雪。
romaji: kore wa zansetsu.
meaning: This is remaining snow, lingering snow.

japanese: 療養に専念すべきです。
romaji: ryouyou ni sennen subekidesu.
meaning: You have to concentrate on your recovery.

japanese: 彼は念願を果たした。
romaji: karehanengan o hata shita.
meaning: He realized his wishes.

japanese: ボクが憧れたのは翔太部長の『力』じゃない。体を張ってでも信念を貫こうとする雄々しい勇気だったはず。
romaji: boku ga akogare tanoha shoutabuchou no ( chikara) janai. karada o hatsu tedemo shinnen o tsuranuko utosuru ooshiiyuuki dattahazu.
meaning: What I looked up to in Shota was not his 'strength'. It was his heroic courage to put his life on the line to carry out his convictions.

japanese: これは号泣。
romaji: kore wa goukyuu.
meaning: This is crying aloud, lamentation, wailing.

japanese: これは涙声。
romaji: kore wa namidagoe.
meaning: This is tearful voice.

japanese: 残念ながらそれは本当なのです。
romaji: zannen nagarasoreha hontou nanodesu.
meaning: It is unfortunately true.

japanese: 泥棒は何の跡も残さずに逃げた。
romaji: dorobou wa nannoato mo nokosa zuni nige ta.
meaning: The thief fled without leaving any traces.

japanese: 彼女はパーティーのために入念な準備をした。
romaji: kanojo wa paateii notameni nyuunen na junbi woshita.
meaning: She made elaborate preparations for the party.

japanese: 民主主義の貴重な成果は国民にとって、非常に大切なものである。だから国民はこの民主主義の理念を維持するために戦う。
romaji: minshushugi no kichou na seika wa kokumin nitotte, hijounitaisetsu namonodearu. dakara kokumin hakono minshushugi no rinen o ijisu rutameni tatakau.
meaning: The precious results of democracy are the apple of the people's eye and the people will fight to maintain these ideals.

japanese: 彼は相変わらず泣き虫だ。
romaji: karehaaikawarazunakimushi da.
meaning: He's a crybaby, just like always.

japanese: 実も結ぶが、挿し木でも根付くらしい？
romaji: mi mo musubu ga, sashiki demo nezuku rashii ？
meaning: It bears fruit, but it seems it may even set root from cuttings?

japanese: できちゃった婚のため身内と大学の友人2人しかよばない地味婚にするそうです。
romaji: dekichatta kon notame miuchi to daigaku no yuujin 2 nin shikayobanai jimikon nisurusoudesu.
meaning: It seems as it was a shot-gun wedding so they're having a quiet wedding with only family and a couple of friends from university invited.

japanese: 興奮の連続に、あっというまもなく３０分のショウタイムが過ぎてしまいました。
romaji: koufun no renzoku ni, attoiumamonaku 3 0 fun no shoutaimu ga sugi teshimaimashita.
meaning: In all the excitement the 30 minute show-time passed in a flash.

japanese: 彼はどんな忠告も意に介さない。
romaji: kareha donna chuukoku mo i ni kaisa nai.
meaning: He doesn't heed any advice.

japanese: 実も結ぶが、挿し木でも根付くらしい？
romaji: mi mo musubu ga, sashiki demo nezuku rashii ？
meaning: It bears fruit, but it seems it may even set root from cuttings?

japanese: これは結う。
romaji: kore wa   yuu.
meaning: This is to do up (hair), to braid, to fasten, to fix.

japanese: これは結わえる。
romaji: kore wa yuwaeru.
meaning: This is to bind, to fasten, to tie up.

japanese: 2006年上海では15万組の夫婦が結婚すると予想されている。
romaji: 2006 toshiueumi deha 15 mankunofuufu ga kekkon suruto yosou sareteiru.
meaning: One hundred and fifty thousand couples are expected to get married in Shanghai in 2006.

japanese: 結果、雨の日は部屋の中でボール遊びをしています。
romaji: kekka, ame no nichi wa heya no naka de booru asobi woshiteimasu.
meaning: As a result, we play ball inside on rainy days.

japanese: これは金婚式。
romaji: kore wa kinkonshiki.
meaning: This is golden wedding (anniversary).

japanese: 新婚なのに子供？そう・・・息子は父親の連れ子。彼はバツイチというわけだ。
romaji: shinkon nanoni kodomo ？ sou ・・・ musuko wa chichioya no tsureko. kareha batsuichi toiuwakeda.
meaning: Newlyweds but with a child? Yes, that's right - the son is from the father's former marriage. He's been divorced once.

japanese: 彼が新進気鋭の学者と新聞で紹介された男かい。
romaji: kare ga shinshinkiei no gakusha to shinbun de shoukai sareta otoko kai.
meaning: Is he the man painted by the newspapers as an up-and-coming scholar?

japanese: これは仲介料。
romaji: kore wa chuukairyou.
meaning: This is agency fee/charge, intermediation fee/charge.

japanese: トムはめったに魚介類を食べない。
romaji: tomu hamettani gyokairui o tabe nai.
meaning: Tom seldom eats seafood.

japanese: そしてもう一つは疑わしい結論を出した。
romaji: soshitemou hitotsu wa utagawashiiketsuron o dashi ta.
meaning: He also brought out one more dubious conclusion.

japanese: 私は婚約を解消しました。
romaji: watashi wa konyaku o kaishou shimashita.
meaning: I have broken off our engagement.

japanese: 日本人には、見知らぬ人と会話を始めてまだくつろいだ気分にならないうちに、相手の、年齢や地位、既婚か未婚かなどの個人的な事柄を知りたがる傾向がある。
romaji: nihonjin niha, mishira nu nin to kaiwa o hajime temadakutsuroida kibun ninaranaiuchini, aite no, nenrei ya chii, kikon ka mikon kanadono kojintekinakotogara o shiri tagaru keikou gaaru.
meaning: There is a tendency for Japanese to want to know a certain amount of personal information about someone such as age, position and whether they are married or not, before they feel comfortable talking with a stranger.

japanese: 何か出そうな定番の場所ですからね。自動演奏するグランドピアノや独りでに動き出す人体模型や。
romaji: nanikadaso una teiban no basho desukarane. jidouensou suru gurandopiano ya hitori deni ugokidasujintaimokei ya.
meaning: That's because they're the classic places for 'something' to appear. Like the grand piano that plays by itself, the human anatomical model that moves by itself ...

japanese: 惰性に身を任せているがために今のような現在があるんですね。
romaji: dasei ni miwomakase teirugatameni ima noyouna genzai gaarundesune.
meaning: I've ended up in my present state from having indulged myself.

japanese: うわっ？これ、勉強に運動神経、全てのパラメータがMAXじゃないか！おまけにお金もカンストするまで貯まってる・・・すげえ。
romaji: uwatsu ？ kore, benkyou ni undoushinkei, subete no parameeta ga MAX janaika! omakenio kin mo kansuto surumade tama tteru ・・・ sugee.
meaning: Wha? Study, reflexes, all the parameters are MAX! You've even saved money up to the limit ... Amazing.

japanese: 私たちの前には、長い道のりが待ち受けています。目の前の斜面は急です。目指すところに、1年ではたどりつかないかもしれない。大統領として1期を丸ごと使っても無理かもしれない。しかしアメリカよ、私たちは絶対にたどり着きます。今夜ほどその期待を強くしたことはありません。
romaji: watashitachi no mae niha, nagaimichinori ga machiuke teimasu. menomae no shamen wa kyuu desu. mezasu tokoroni, 1 nen dehatadoritsukanaikamoshirenai. daitouryou toshite 1 ki o maru goto tsukatte mo muri kamoshirenai. shikashi amerika yo, watashitachi wa zettai nitadori tsuki masu. konya hodosono kitai o tsuyoku shitakotohaarimasen.
meaning: The road ahead will be long. Our climb will be steep. We may not get there in one year or even in one term. But, America, I have never been more hopeful than I am tonight that we WILL get there.

japanese: 惰性に身を任せているがために今のような現在があるんですね。
romaji: dasei ni miwomakase teirugatameni ima noyouna genzai gaarundesune.
meaning: I've ended up in my present state from having indulged myself.

japanese: 私たちの前には、長い道のりが待ち受けています。目の前の斜面は急です。目指すところに、1年ではたどりつかないかもしれない。大統領として1期を丸ごと使っても無理かもしれない。しかしアメリカよ、私たちは絶対にたどり着きます。今夜ほどその期待を強くしたことはありません。
romaji: watashitachi no mae niha, nagaimichinori ga machiuke teimasu. menomae no shamen wa kyuu desu. mezasu tokoroni, 1 nen dehatadoritsukanaikamoshirenai. daitouryou toshite 1 ki o maru goto tsukatte mo muri kamoshirenai. shikashi amerika yo, watashitachi wa zettai nitadori tsuki masu. konya hodosono kitai o tsuyoku shitakotohaarimasen.
meaning: The road ahead will be long. Our climb will be steep. We may not get there in one year or even in one term. But, America, I have never been more hopeful than I am tonight that we WILL get there.

japanese: 彼女が独身だとはうれしいね。
romaji: kanojo ga dokushin datohaureshiine.
meaning: I'm glad to hear that she is unmarried.

japanese: 米国の人民は独立のために戦った。
romaji: beikoku no jinmin wa dokuritsu notameni tatakatsu ta.
meaning: The people of America fought for their independence.

japanese: 彼は独り言を言いました。
romaji: karehahitorigoto o ii mashita.
meaning: He talked to himself.

japanese: これは身近な。
romaji: kore wa mijikana.
meaning: This is near oneself, close to one, familiar.

japanese: 彼女はあなたとだいたい同じくらいの身長だ。
romaji: kanojo haanatatodaitai onaji kuraino shinchou da.
meaning: She's about the same height as you.

japanese: 会社をクビになったけど、貯金がすこしあるので、差し詰め生活には困らない。
romaji: kaisha o kubi ninattakedo, chokin gasukoshiarunode, sashitsumeseikatsu niha komara nai.
meaning: I got the sack but I've a little saved up, so for the time being I won't be troubled by living expenses.

japanese: これは貯蔵。
romaji: kore wa chozou.
meaning: This is storage, preservation.

japanese: ただし、学生の本分は学業ですから、期末テストをおろそかにしたらメッ！ですよ？
romaji: tadashi, gakusei no honbun wa gakugyou desukara, kimatsu tesuto woorosokanishitara metsu! desuyo ？
meaning: However, the duty of a student is to study. So if you neglect the end of term test, that's a "no!".

japanese: それは君の腕次第かな。期待してるよ。
romaji: soreha kun no udeshidai kana. kitaishi teruyo.
meaning: I suppose that depends on how good you are. I'm counting on you!

japanese: 将来、いつかコンピューターが文学作品の翻訳に着手するようになれば、われわれが知るような文学は最期を迎えることになるだろう。
romaji: shourai, itsuka konpyuutaa ga bungakusakuhin no honyaku ni chakushu suruyouninareba, warewarega shiru youna bungaku wa saigo o mukae rukotoninarudarou.
meaning: When, one day, computers undertake to translate literary works, it will be the end of literature as we know it.

japanese: 彼らは息子達が独り立ちできるよう育てた。
romaji: karera wa musukotachi ga hitoritachi dekiruyou sodate ta.
meaning: They had brought up their sons to stand on their own feet.

japanese: ご出身はどちらですか。
romaji: go shusshin hadochiradesuka.
meaning: Where are you from?

japanese: 彼は身分の高い人です。
romaji: karehamibun no takainin desu.
meaning: He is a man of high social status.

japanese: 輸送中に箱が拉げて中身がとび出した。
romaji: yusouchuu ni hako ga hisage te nakami gatobi dashi ta.
meaning: The box was crushed during transport and the contents flew out.

japanese: 同社の第４四半期の業績は前期に比べ、急激に改善した。
romaji: dousha no daiyonshihanki no gyouseki wa zenki ni kurabe, kyuugeki ni kaizen shita.
meaning: The company's fourth quarter results sharply improved from the preceding quarter.

japanese: 日本では新学期は４月に始まる。
romaji: nippon deha shingakki wa 4 gatsu ni hajima ru.
meaning: In Japan a new school year starts in April.

japanese: 勧工場には約２０の出店が並んだ。
romaji: kankouba niha yaku 2 0 no demise ga naran da.
meaning: There was a row of about 20 stalls at the fair.

japanese: 本はひとまとめに束ねてあった。
romaji: hon hahitomatomeni tabane teatta.
meaning: The books were tied up in a bundle.

japanese: 汚い行為の報いは必ず自分に返ってくる。
romaji: kitanaikoui no mukui wa kanarazujibun ni kaetsu tekuru.
meaning: What goes around comes around.

japanese: 娘はいつも、約束を守らない母親に苛立っていた。
romaji: musume haitsumo, yakusoku o mamora nai hahaoya ni iradatsu teita.
meaning: The daughter was irritated with her mother, who always broke her promises.

japanese: ※基本的な禁止事項（誹謗・中傷の禁止等）は「はじめにお読み下さい」に記載してあります。必ずお読みください。
romaji: ※ kihonteki na kinshijikou ( hibou ・ chuushou no kinshinado) wa ( hajimenio yomikudasai) ni kisaishi tearimasu. kanarazu o yomi kudasai.
meaning: * The basic prohibitions (No slander, libel, etc.) are noted in the "Read me first." Please be sure to read it.

japanese: 汚い行為の報いは必ず自分に返ってくる。
romaji: kitanaikoui no mukui wa kanarazujibun ni kaetsu tekuru.
meaning: What goes around comes around.

japanese: 浪費する人を守るために倹約する人に税金をかけるのは、賢明なことではないし、結局はためにならないのである。
romaji: rouhi suru nin o mamoru tameni kenyaku suru nin ni zeikin wokakerunoha, kenmei nakotodehanaishi, kekkyoku hatameninaranainodearu.
meaning: It is not wise, nor in the long run is it kind, to tax the thrifty for the thriftless.

japanese: 約束は守りなさい。
romaji: yakusoku wa mamori nasai.
meaning: You must keep your promise.

japanese: 約束は守りなさい。
romaji: yakusoku wa mamori nasai.
meaning: You must keep your promise.

japanese: ６月末に参加者を募ったら１週間弱で約５００席が予約でいっぱいになった。
romaji: 6 getsumatsu ni sankasha o tsunotsu tara 1 shuukanjaku de yaku 5 0 0 seki ga yoyaku deippaininatta.
meaning: When participants were sought at the end of June all, about 500, seats were reserved in under a week.

japanese: 彼女を元気付けるために病院に花束を送った。
romaji: kanojo o genkitsukeru tameni byouin ni hanataba o okutsu ta.
meaning: We sent some flowers to the hospital to cheer her up.

japanese: これは必勝。
romaji: kore wa hisshou.
meaning: This is certain victory&nbsp.

japanese: これは子守歌。
romaji: kore wa komoriuta.
meaning: This is lullaby.

japanese: 彼はよい打者であるだけでなくすばらしい守備の選手でもある。
romaji: kareha yoi dasha dearudakedenakusubarashii shubi no senshu demoaru.
meaning: He is not only a good batter but also a wonderful defense.

japanese: 同世代の人は、仕事とか、買い物で留守ばかりです。
romaji: dousedai no nin ha, shigoto toka, kaimono de rusu bakaridesu.
meaning: My contemporaries are, working, shopping, out and about, all the time.

japanese: 私はその商品の予約を解約した。
romaji: watashi hasono shouhin no yoyaku o kaiyaku shita.
meaning: I canceled my order for the commodities.

japanese: これは結束。
romaji: kore wa kessoku.
meaning: This is union, unity, solidarity, bundling, binding, tying, putting on (clothes, armor, etc.).

japanese: 彼は人々を束縛から解放した。
romaji: karehahitobito o sokubaku kara kaihou shita.
meaning: He liberated the people from bondage.

japanese: 人生、一期一会というじゃないの。出会いを大切にしようよ。
romaji: jinsei, ichigoichie toiujanaino. deai o taisetsu nishiyouyo.
meaning: Treasure every encounter with others because you never know if you'll meet a person just once in your lifetime.

japanese: クリントン陣営は、両州でオバマが取った白人票を取り崩そうと必死になった。
romaji: kurinton jin'ei ha, ryoushuu de obama ga totsu ta hakujinhyou o torikuzuso uto hisshi ninatta.
meaning: The Clinton camp became desperate to eliminate the white votes Obama had got in both states.

japanese: 彼は利口でそのうえ正直で時間を厳守する。
romaji: kareharikou desonoue shoujiki de jikan o genshu suru.
meaning: He is smart, and what is more, honest and punctual.

japanese: 社長の挨拶が長くて式の後半が押せ押せになってしまった。
romaji: shachou no aisatsu ga nagaku te shiki no kouhan ga oseose ninatteshimatta.
meaning: The company president's welcome was so long that we were squeezed for time in the second half of the ceremony.

japanese: 列を上に下に歩き回る時、「ホットドッグはいかが。ホットドッグはいかが」と叫ぶ。
romaji: retsu o uenishitaniarukimawarutoki, ( hottodoggu haikaga. hottodoggu haikaga) to sakebu.
meaning: As they walk up and down the rows they shout, "Get your hot dogs here! Get your hot dogs!"

japanese: 有難くも、10000hit越えのお祝いイラストを頂いてしまいました！本当にかたじけないです。
romaji: arigataku mo, 10000hit koe noo iwai irasuto o itadai teshimaimashita! hontou nikatajikenaidesu.
meaning: I'm very lucky to have been gifted with this 10,000 hit picture! Thank you so very much.

japanese: そういえば、電車の中で隣に座ったほろ酔いのおっさんに、自分の俳句を見て欲しいと言われたことがある。
romaji: souieba, densha no naka de tonari ni suwatsu tahoro yoi noossanni, jibun no haiku o mitehoshii to iwa retakotogaaru.
meaning: Now that I think of it, I've been asked to look at a haiku he'd written by the tipsy bloke sitting next to me on the train.

japanese: 彼らはプレゼントでクリスマスを祝う。
romaji: karera wa purezento de kurisumasu o iwau.
meaning: They celebrate Christmas with presents.

japanese: 有難くも、10000hit越えのお祝いイラストを頂いてしまいました！本当にかたじけないです。
romaji: arigataku mo, 10000hit koe noo iwai irasuto o itadai teshimaimashita! hontou nikatajikenaidesu.
meaning: I'm very lucky to have been gifted with this 10,000 hit picture! Thank you so very much.

japanese: 彼は酔うと手がつけられない。
romaji: karehayou to tega tsukerarenai.
meaning: He is out of control when drunk.

japanese: ２００２年：国土安全保障省設立法にブッシュ大統領がサインし正式な省となる。
romaji: 2 0 0 2 nen: kokudoanzenhoshoushousetsuritsuhou ni busshu daitouryou ga sain shi seishiki na shou tonaru.
meaning: 2002: President Bush signs the Homeland Security Act and it becomes an official Cabinet agency.

japanese: 結婚式ではあまりにたくさんのごちそうが出されたので、新郎新婦はもっと多くの人を呼ぶべきだったかなと思い始めた。
romaji: kekkonshiki dehaamarinitakusannogochisouga dasa retanode, shinroushinpu hamotto ooku no nin o yobu bekidattakanato omoihajime ta.
meaning: Food and drink were served in such profusion at the wedding that the bride and groom began to wonder if they should not have invited more guests.

japanese: 書式に必ず署名押印してください。
romaji: shoshiki ni kanarazushomeiouin shitekudasai.
meaning: Please be sure to sign and seal the form.

japanese: 子どもたちがサーカスの行列を追いかけた。
romaji: kodomo tachiga saakasu no gyouretsu o oi kaketa.
meaning: The children chased after the circus parade.

japanese: 日本は列島であり、山が多く、森は殆どない。
romaji: nippon wa retsushima deari, yama ga ooku, mori wa hotondo nai.
meaning: Japan is a group of islands with many mountains and almost no forests.

japanese: これは祝賀。
romaji: kore wa shukuga.
meaning: This is celebrations, congratulations.

japanese: 休みの前などは少し羽目を外して飲むのだが、杜仲茶割りで飲むと二日酔いが全くない。
romaji: yasumi no mae nadoha sukoshihame o hazushi te nomu nodaga, tochuuchawari de nomu to futsukayoi ga mattaku nai.
meaning: I usually cut loose a bit and drink plenty before a day off work, but if my drinks are cut with tochu tea, then I get absolutely no hangover.

japanese: たった一センチで酔っ払いますか！健介は酒豪だったと言うのに。
romaji: tatta ichi senchi de yotsuharai masuka! kensuke wa shugou dattato iu noni.
meaning: You get drunk on just one centimeter? And Kensuke was such a heavy drinker.

japanese: ゆうべ、泥酔のみずきは湖のほとりを歩いていて、水の中に落ちてしまった。
romaji: yuube, deisui nomizukiha mizuumi nohotoriwo arui teite, mizu no nakaniochi teshimatta.
meaning: Last night, Mizuki was completely drunk and she was walking along the lake, and then she fell in the water.

japanese: これは一式。
romaji: kore wa isshiki.
meaning: This is complete set, all, everything.

japanese: 株式は一晩のうちに下がった。
romaji: kabushiki wa hitoban nouchini saga tta.
meaning: The stock has gone down overnight.

japanese: ジュネーブから来る列車が駅に到着します。
romaji: juneebu kara kururessha ga eki ni touchaku shimasu.
meaning: The train from Geneva will arrive at the station.

japanese: 私たちは国民の祝日に旗を立てる。
romaji: watashitachi wa kokumin no shukujitsu ni hata o tate ru.
meaning: We put up the flags on national holidays.

japanese: これは祝儀。
romaji: kore wa shuugi.
meaning: This is congratulations, celebration, congratulatory gift, tip.

japanese: 恥を忍んで生き永らえるよりむしろ死にたい。
romaji: haji o shinon de ikinagara eruyorimushiro shini tai.
meaning: I would die before I live on in shame.

japanese: 僕には警察よりも何よりもみんながいてくれることの方が心強いのですよ。
romaji: boku niha keisatsu yorimo nani yorimominnagaitekurerukotono hougakokorozuyoi nodesuyo.
meaning: For my part, having you lot with me is more reassuring than the police or anything!

japanese: お願いだから泣かないで。
romaji: o negai dakara naka naide.
meaning: Please don't cry.

japanese: 息子が何とか勉強する気になってくれることを願うよ。
romaji: musuko ga nantokabenkyou suru kini nattekurerukotowo negau yo.
meaning: I hope my son will bring himself to study hard.

japanese: 他の誰かが彼女を幸せにしたとしても彼女が幸せなら、それで良い。
romaji: hokanodareka ga kanojo o shiawase nishitatoshitemo kanojo ga shiawase nara, sorede yoi.
meaning: Even if it was somebody else who made her happy, as long as she is happy, that's fine.

japanese: 何はともあれ、大事にいたらなかったのは、不幸中の幸いであった。
romaji: nani hatomoare, daiji niitaranakattanoha, fukouchuu no saiwai deatta.
meaning: At any rate, that it had ended without serious incident was a small mercy.

japanese: 他の誰かが彼女を幸せにしたとしても彼女が幸せなら、それで良い。

japanese: 他の誰かが彼女を幸せにしたとしても彼女が幸せなら、それで良い。
romaji: hokanodareka ga kanojo o shiawase nishitatoshitemo kanojo ga shiawase nara, sorede yoi.

japanese: 彼は会社をくびになったんだけど、わざわい転じて福となすで、見事独立したから偉いよ。
romaji: karehakaisha wokubininattandakedo, wazawai tenji te fuku tonasude, migotodokuritsu shitakara erai yo.
meaning: His old company gave him the shaft. But I admire the way he turned bad luck into good and did even better with his own business.

japanese: 人間は決して永遠には生きられないものだ。
romaji: ningen wa kesshiteeien niha iki rarenaimonoda.
meaning: Humans were never meant to live forever.

japanese: 彼女はアメリカに永住することに決めた。
romaji: kanojo wa amerika ni eijuu surukotoni kime ta.
meaning: She has decided to live in America for good.

japanese: 彼は東京銀行へ就職の願書を出した。
romaji: karehatoukyouginkou e shuushoku no gansho o dashi ta.
meaning: He applied for a job with the Bank of Tokyo.

japanese: 良いベビーシッターが見つけられて幸運だった。
romaji: yoi bebiishittaa ga mitsu kerarete kouun datta.
meaning: I was lucky that I was able to find a good babysitter.

japanese: これは社会福祉士。
romaji: kore wa shakaifukushishi.
meaning: This is social worker.

japanese: １つ１つの出願を１件ずつ考慮しなければならないだろう。
romaji: 1 tsu 1 tsuno shutsugan o 1 ken zutsu kouryoshi nakerebanaranaidarou.

japanese: 僕は不幸かも知れないけれど自殺はしない。
romaji: bokuhafukou kamo shire naikeredo jisatsu hashinai.
meaning: I'd be unhappy, but I wouldn't kill myself.

japanese: 彼は、そこにいたら幸福なのに、と言った。
romaji: kareha, sokoniitara koufuku nanoni, to itta.
meaning: He says that if he were there he would be happy.

japanese: 司祭は私に彼の祝福を与えた。
romaji: shisai wa watashi ni kanoshukufuku o atae ta.
meaning: The priest gave me his blessing.

japanese: 馬鹿が移るまえにそのような宗教に関わらんほうがいい。
romaji: baka ga utsuru maenisonoyouna shuukyou ni kakawa ranhougaii.
meaning: You should stay away from cults like that before you turn into a moron.

japanese: 虫歯を侮ると命に係わる場合もあるのです。
romaji: mushiba o anadoru to inochi ni kakawa ru baai moarunodesu.
meaning: Making light of cavities can be a matter of life and death.

japanese: 老人の怒りも和らいだ。
romaji: roujin no ikari mo yawara ida.

japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
romaji: watashi hahizawo mage zuni ryouhou no teno hirawo toko ni tsukeru kotogadekiru.

japanese: どれくらいかかるのかしら。
romaji: dorekuraikakarunokashira.
meaning: I wonder how long it's going to take.

japanese: 木で風の力が和らぐ。
romaji: ki de kaze no chikara ga yawara gu.
meaning: The tree breaks the wind.

japanese: 彼は話を和らげるために若干の冗談を必要とする。
romaji: karehahanashi o yawara gerutameni jakkan no joudan o hitsuyou tosuru.
meaning: He needs a few jokes to lighten up his talk.

japanese: メアリーがいるだけで、場が和むわね。
romaji: mearii gairudakede, ba ga nagomu wane.
meaning: Just having Mary around makes the atmosphere relaxed.

japanese: これは和やかな。
romaji: kore wa nagayakana.
meaning: This is mild, calm, gentle, quiet, harmonious.

japanese: 目に付くものが欲しいものだ。
romaji: menitsuku monoga hoshii monoda.
meaning: What you see is what you want.

japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
romaji: watashi hahizawo mage zuni ryouhou no teno hirawo toko ni tsukeru kotogadekiru.
meaning: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

japanese: これは関所。
romaji: kore wa sekisho.
meaning: This is barrier, checking station.

japanese: 玄関にも取り付け可能な暗証タイプです。
romaji: genkan nimo toritsukekanounaanshou taipu desu.
meaning: This is a code lock type that you can use on the entranceway as well.

japanese: 怠けているような人とは関わるな。
romaji: namake teiruyouna nin toha kakawa runa.
meaning: Avoid those men who are idle.

japanese: 係員が頷いたので彼女は小切手を書き、それを手渡した。
romaji: kakariin ga unazui tanode kanojo wa kogitte o kaki, sorewo tewatashi ta.
meaning: The clerk nodded, so the woman wrote a check and handed it over.

japanese: 母ちゃんも同じ事いってたな。だからどうしたってんだよ。オレにゃ関係ない。
romaji: kaachan mo onajikoto ittetana. dakaradoushitattendayo. ore nya kankei nai.
meaning: Mum said the same thing. But, so what? It's got nothing to do with me.

japanese: 痛みは少し和らぎました。
romaji: itami wa sukoshiyawara gimashita.
meaning: The pain has lessened a bit.

japanese: 和食のレストランへ行くたびに、割り箸を家へもって帰ります。
romaji: washoku no resutoran e iku tabini, waribashi o ie hemotte kaeri masu.
meaning: Whenever I go to a Japanese restaurant, I take the disposable chopsticks home with me.

japanese: 今私の家の付近に住宅が続々建っている。
romaji: imawatashi no ie no fukin ni juutaku ga zokuzokutatsu teiru.
meaning: In my neighborhood, houses are now being built one after another.

japanese: 台風が関東地方に上陸した。
romaji: taifuu ga kantouchihou ni jouriku shita.
meaning: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.

japanese: 別にブルマに特別な関心があるわけじゃない。そういうフェティシズムはない、と思う。
romaji: betsuni buruma ni tokubetsu na kanshin gaaruwakejanai. souiu feteishizumu hanai, to omou.
meaning: It's not like I've got any special interest in gym shorts - I've not got that fetish, I think.

japanese: 母は私にお皿を片付けるようにと言った。
romaji: haha wa watashi nio sara o katazuke ruyounito itta.
meaning: Mother told me to put away the dishes.

japanese: 大抵の学芸は、最初に基礎をしっかりやっておかないと、その先スムーズに身に付けることができません。
romaji: taitei no gakugei ha, saisho ni kiso woshikkariyatteokanaito, sono saki sumuuzu ni minitsuke rukotogadekimasen.
meaning: With most of the arts, if you don't get the basics down properly then it is difficult to acquire further skills.

japanese: 私の娘は尻が重いので困る。
romaji: watashi no musume wa shiri ga omoi node komaru.
meaning: My daughter's slowness to take action is a pain.

japanese: 祖父は祖母がぽっくり逝ってから急に老け込みました。
romaji: sofu wa sobo gapokkuri itsu tekara kyuunifukekomi mashita.
meaning: After Grandma's sudden death, Grandpa began to age rapidly.

japanese: いつかフランスに行くことは避けられない、それがいつかは分からないけれど。
romaji: itsuka furansu ni iku kotoha sake rarenai, soregaitsukaha waka ranaikeredo.
meaning: It is inevitable that I go to France someday, I just don't know when.

japanese: 彼女は結婚前スミス姓だった。
romaji: kanojo wa kekkonmae sumisu sei datta.
meaning: She was a Smith before her marriage.

japanese: 生きることは老いること。それだけ。
romaji: iki rukotoha oi rukoto. soredake.
meaning: Living is growing old, nothing more.

japanese: 彼は働いていなければならないときによく飲酒にふける。
romaji: karehahatarai teinakerebanaranaitokiniyoku inshu nifukeru.
meaning: He often indulges in drinking when he should be working.

japanese: そればかりの年金では老後の生活が不安です。
romaji: sorebakarino nenkin deha rougo no seikatsu ga fuan desu.
meaning: With only that much pension I'm concerned about life in retirement.

japanese: 2006年上海では15万組の夫婦が結婚すると予想されている。
romaji: 2006 toshiueumi deha 15 mankunofuufu ga kekkon suruto yosou sareteiru.
meaning: One hundred and fifty thousand couples are expected to get married in Shanghai in 2006.

japanese: ブルース夫人は英日間を飛んだ最初の女性パイロットであった。
romaji: buruusu fujin wa einichikan o ton da saisho no josei pairotto deatta.
meaning: Mrs. Bruce was the first female pilot to fly between England and Japan.

japanese: これは主婦業。
romaji: kore wa shufugyou.
meaning: This is house wife work, house work, Hausfrauentätigkeit, Hausarbeit.

japanese: 新婦は白いウエディングドレスに身を包んでいた。
romaji: shinpu wa shiroi uedingudoresu ni miwotsutsun deita.
meaning: The bride was wearing a white wedding dress.

japanese: 私は自分と同姓同名の女性を知っている。
romaji: watashi wa jibun to douseidoumei no josei o shitte iru.
meaning: I know a woman whose first and last names are the same as mine.

japanese: 敬老の日には祖父母を訪ねて孝行します。
romaji: keirou no nichi niha sofubo o tazune te koukou shimasu.
meaning: On the Respect-for-Senior-Citizens Day, we visit our grandparents and do nice things for them.

japanese: 彼は死んだものと老夫婦はあきらめていた。
romaji: karehashin damonoto roufuufu haakirameteita.
meaning: The old couple gave him up for lost.

japanese: 冷凍食品をじょうずに利用している主婦が多い。
romaji: reitoushokuhin wojouzuni riyou shiteiru shufu ga ooi.
meaning: Many housewives make good use of frozen food.

japanese: 早朝の受付でクジを引いて順番を決めた。
romaji: souchou no uketsuke de kuji o hii te junban o kime ta.
meaning: We drew lots to decide who would go first at the early morning reception desk.

japanese: 衣ばかりで和尚はできぬ。
romaji: koromo bakaride oshou hadekinu.
meaning: The dress does not make the fair.

japanese: 彼の両親はお百姓でした。
romaji: kanoryoushin hao hyakushou deshita.
meaning: His parents were farmers.

japanese: 「恵子の男関係が知りたいかな」「男関係？」「誰と仲が良いとか、誰とつきあったとか」
romaji: ( keiko no otokokankei ga shiri taikana) ( otokokankei ？) ( dare to naka ga yoi toka, dare totsukiattatoka)
meaning: "I might like to know about your relations with men." "Relations with men?" "Things like who you get on well with, who you've dated and such."

japanese: 君は僕にとてもいらいらしている。
romaji: kun wa boku nitotemoirairashiteiru.

japanese: 彼は時々変です。
romaji: karehatokidokihende su.

japanese: 何か他の言い方はある？
