romaji: mama ~! anoo neechan too niichan, o tetetsunai de, suggoku nakayoshi sandane ~!
meaning: Mama! That lady and man are holding hands, they're great friends aren't they!

japanese: 彼女の仲裁が私たちの口論を終わらせた。
romaji: kanojo no chuusai ga watashitachi no kouron o owa raseta.
meaning: Her mediation put an end to our quarrel.

japanese: もう彼女には言えないよ。そんなに単純なことではなくなってきたからね。
romaji: mou kanojo niha ie naiyo. sonnani tanjunna kotodehanakunattekitakarane.
meaning: I can't tell her now. It's not that simple anymore.

japanese: 彼氏が留置所に入って10日経ちました。
romaji: kareshi ga ryuuchitokoro ni itsutsu te 10 nikkei chimashita.
meaning: It's been 10 days since my boyfriend went to jail.

japanese: 暑さ寒さも彼岸まで。
romaji: atsusasamusa mo higan made.
meaning: No heat or cold lasts beyond the equinox.

japanese: 彼らは他国の内政に干渉すべきではない。
romaji: karera wa takoku no naisei ni kanshou subekidehanai.
meaning: They should not intervene in the internal affairs of another country.

japanese: 孤独な人は、他人を恐れるから一人なのだ。
romaji: kodoku na nin ha, tanin o osore rukara hitori nanoda.
meaning: Every person who is alone is alone because they are afraid of others.

japanese: 企業経営で活躍するために必要となるのが多くの仲間と仕事を遂行するための協調精神です。
romaji: kigyoukeiei de katsuyaku surutameni hitsuyou tonarunoga ooku no nakama to shigoto o suikou surutameno kyouchouseishin desu.
meaning: What you need to take part in business management is the team spirit to work with many colleagues.

japanese: これは仲介する。
romaji: kore wa chuukaisuru.
meaning: This is agency, intermediation.

japanese: 私たちはだれでも、他者との一体感を切望する何かをうちに秘めている。
romaji: watashitachi hadaredemo, tasha tono ittaikan o setsubou suru nanika wouchini hime teiru.
meaning: Each of us has something in us that longs for a sense of oneness with others.

japanese: 他言無用でお願いします。
romaji: tagonmuyou deo negai shimasu.
meaning: Not a word to anyone, please.

japanese: あの夫婦は私たちの仲人です。
romaji: ano fuufu wa watashitachi no nakoudo desu.
meaning: That couple is our go-between.

japanese: 初めから果敢に前へ出て圧倒し、体勢を崩した相手を押し出した。
romaji: hajime kara kakan ni mae e deteattou shi, taisei o kuzushi ta aite o oshidashi ta.
meaning: He resolutely pushed forward from the start, overwhelming and pushing out his off-balance opponent.

japanese: 本を再び読み続けた。
romaji: hon o futatabiyomitsuzuke ta.
meaning: I went on with my reading.

japanese: 私も、ほんとに久々に家庭でくつろいだ時間を過ごしたって感じ。
romaji: watashi mo, hontoni hisabisa ni katei dekutsuroida jikan o sugo shitatte kanji.
meaning: I also really had the feeling of having had a relaxed day with my family for the first time in a long while.

japanese: 予期しない結果に達した。
romaji: yoki shinai kekka ni tasshi ta.
meaning: An unexpected result came about.

japanese: 秋風が立ち初める。
romaji: akikaze ga tachihajime ru.
meaning: An autumn breeze begins to blow.

japanese: 初めから果敢に前へ出て圧倒し、体勢を崩した相手を押し出した。
romaji: hajime kara kakan ni mae e deteattou shi, taisei o kuzushi ta aite o oshidashi ta.
meaning: He resolutely pushed forward from the start, overwhelming and pushing out his off-balance opponent.

japanese: 凄いです！こんな感動的な話は初めてです！まさに美談の中の美談です！
romaji: sugoi desu! konna kandouteki na hanashi wa hajimete desu! masani bidan no nakanobidan desu!
meaning: Amazing! This moving a story is a first for me! It's truly an epic among epics!

japanese: 初めから果敢に前へ出て圧倒し、体勢を崩した相手を押し出した。
romaji: hajime kara kakan ni mae e deteattou shi, taisei o kuzushi ta aite o oshidashi ta.
meaning: He resolutely pushed forward from the start, overwhelming and pushing out his off-balance opponent.

japanese: 彼は再びやってみる決心をした。
romaji: karehafutatabi yattemiru kesshin woshita.
meaning: He made up his mind to try again.

japanese: 本を再び読み続けた。
romaji: hon o futatabiyomitsuzuke ta.
meaning: I went on with my reading.

japanese: 彼が学校を出てからずいぶん久しい。
romaji: kare ga gakkou o dete karazuibun hisashii.
meaning: It's such a long time since he left school.

japanese: これは書き初め。
romaji: kore wa kakizome.
meaning: This is first calligraphy of the year.

japanese: これは初々しい。
romaji: kore wa uiuishii.
meaning: This is innocent, artless, unsophisticated, fresh.

japanese: 大学での初日はかなり退屈だった。
romaji: daigaku deno shonichi hakanari taikutsu datta.
meaning: My first day in the university was rather boring.

japanese: これは再試験。
romaji: kore wa saishiken.
meaning: This is reexamination.

japanese: 新校舎は、再来年の夏に完成予定です。
romaji: shinkousha ha, sarainen no natsu ni kanseiyotei desu.
meaning: The new school building is expected to be completed in summer the year after next.

japanese: これは久しく。
romaji: kore wa hisashiku.
meaning: This is for a long time.

japanese: 良書は最良の友であり、今日も今後も永久に同じである。
romaji: ryousho wa sairyou no tomo deari, kyou mo kongo mo eikyuu ni onaji dearu.
meaning: A good book is the best of friends, the same today and forever.

japanese: 能力には早く上達するものとゆっくり上達するものがありますよね？
romaji: nouryoku niha hayakujoutatsu surumonotoyukkuri joutatsu surumonogaarimasuyone ？
meaning: There are abilities that improve rapidly and those that improve slowly, aren't there?

japanese: まもなく初雪が降った。
romaji: mamonaku hatsuyuki ga futsu ta.
meaning: The first snow came before long.

japanese: 初心を貫徹したらどうですか。
romaji: shoshin o kantetsu shitaradoudesuka.
meaning: Why don't you carry out what you've set out to do?

japanese: この空港は新千歳空港ほど便数が多くないので、送迎デッキから見ても最初は飛行機がいませんでした。
romaji: kono kuukou wa shinchitosekuukou hodo binsuu ga ooku nainode, sougei dekki kara mite mo saisho wa hikouki gaimasendeshita.
meaning: This airport doesn't have as many flights as New Chitose Airport and even looking from the observation deck at first there were no planes.

japanese: もうすぐ授業が再開する。
romaji: mousugu jugyou ga saikai suru.
meaning: Classes are starting again soon.

japanese: 朝起きて、挨拶を交わす相手がいる——久しぶりの感覚だ。
romaji: asaoki te, aisatsu o majiwa su aite gairu — — hisashi burino kankaku da.
meaning: To get up in the morning, and there be someone to say good morning to - I haven't had this feeling for a long time.

japanese: 速達にしてくれませんか。
romaji: sokutatsu nishitekuremasenka.
meaning: Can you make it special delivery?

japanese: こちらは私の友達のレイチェルです。私たちは同じ高校に通っていました。
romaji: kochiraha watashi no tomodachi no reicheru desu. watashitachi wa onajikoukou ni tootte imashita.
meaning: This is my friend Rachel. We went to high school together.

japanese: これは屋久島。
romaji: kore wa yakushima.
meaning: This is Yakushima, Kagoshima.

japanese: 面疔ができた。小鼻の奥に1個、痛い塊がある。
romaji: menchou gadekita. kobana no oku ni 1 ko, itaikai gaaru.
meaning: I have a facial boil. There's a painful lump at the back of one nostril.

japanese: しかしながら、これらの溶剤は発がん性が指摘された。
romaji: shikashinagara, korerano youzai wa hatsugansei ga shiteki sareta.
meaning: However, these solvents were identified as carcinogenic.

japanese: 台座に心棒を立てて、各パーツをずらしながら重ねていきます。
romaji: daiza ni shinbou o tate te, kaku paatsu wozurashinagara omone teikimasu.
meaning: You stand the axis on the base and then proceed to stack up each part, staggering their position.

japanese: 格が5つ以上ある言語はこれまで全部挫折してきました。
romaji: kaku ga 5 tsu ijou aru gengo hakoremade zenbuzasetsu shitekimashita.
meaning: Up until now, languages with more than four cases have only caused me frustration.

japanese: 個室を予約したいのですが？
romaji: koshitsu o yoyaku shitainodesuga ？
meaning: I'd like to reserve a private compartment.

japanese: 彼女は非常に個性的な人だ。
romaji: kanojo wa hijounikoseiteki na nin da.
meaning: She has a very strong personality.

japanese: 小学校のときから、酸性・アルカリ性という性質をリトマス紙で調べたりしてきていますね。
romaji: shougakkou notokikara, sansei ・arukari sei toiu seishitsu o ritomasu kami de shirabe tarishitekiteimasune.
meaning: Since primary school we've been checking for the qualities known as acidity and alkalinity with litmus paper.

japanese: 星占いによると彼女と僕はあまり相性がよくないようだ。
romaji: hoshiuranai niyoruto kanojo to bokuha amari aishou gayokunaiyouda.
meaning: According to the stars, she and I aren't supposed to have much chemistry between us.

japanese: 各国の政治家がホワイトハウス詣でをした。
romaji: kakkoku no seijika ga howaitohausu moude woshita.
meaning: Politicians from many countries made pilgrimages to the White House.

japanese: 各自の部署に就け。
romaji: kakuji no busho ni tsuke.
meaning: Go to your posts.

japanese: 私はいつも不思議な性格の方が好きだった。
romaji: watashi haitsumo fushigi na seikaku no hougasuki datta.
meaning: I always liked mysterious characters more.

japanese: 自分の仕事や関心事について話し、また相手のそうしたことについて尋ねるのはいいが、話題があまりに個人的なものにならないよう気を付けなさい。
romaji: jibun no shigoto ya kanshinji nitsuite hanashi, mata aite nosoushitakotonitsuite tazune runohaiiga, wadai gaamarini kojintekina mononinaranaiyou kiwotsuke nasai.
meaning: It is acceptable to mention your job and interests and to ask the other person about his, but be careful not to let the conversation become too personal.

japanese: 佐渡さんは魅力的な個性の持ち主なのに、その価値が分からず、自分を好まない。
romaji: sado sanha miryokuteki na kosei no mochinushi nanoni, sono kachi ga waka razu, jibun o konoma nai.
meaning: Even though Sato has a nice personality, he doesn't know its value and doesn't like himself.

japanese: 女性がいなければ世界はどうなっていただろう。
romaji: josei gainakereba sekai hadounatteitadarou.
meaning: What would the world be without women?

japanese: これは水性。
romaji: kore wa suisei.
meaning: This is aqueous, water-based.

japanese: 彼女はその気性を祖父から受け継いでいる。
romaji: kanojo hasono kishou o sofu kara uketsui deiru.
meaning: She derives her temper from her grandfather.

japanese: これは合格祈願。
romaji: kore wa goukakukigan.
meaning: This is prayer for passing an exam, prayer for school success.

japanese: 彼女は華奢な体格だ。
romaji: kanojo wa kyasha na taikaku da.
meaning: She is delicately constituted.

japanese: 労働はただ単に必要なものであるばかりか、楽しみでもある。
romaji: roudou hatada tannihitsuyou namonodearubakarika, tanoshimi demoaru.
meaning: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.

japanese: 彼女はゴルフクラブに入会を申し込んだ。
romaji: kanojo wa gorufukurabu ni nyuukai o moushikon da.
meaning: She applied for the membership in a golf club.

japanese: 学校に全てを求めることはできない。
romaji: gakkou ni subete o motome rukotohadekinai.
meaning: One can't expect everything from schools.

japanese: 毒を以て毒を制す。
romaji: doku o motedoku o sei su.
meaning: Diamond cuts diamond.

japanese: 学校に全てを求めることはできない。
romaji: gakkou ni subete o motome rukotohadekinai.
meaning: One can't expect everything from schools.

japanese: それは全くの真実です。
romaji: soreha mattaku no shinjitsu desu.
meaning: That's the absolute truth.

japanese: 肩関節は、単独で動くほか、腕の動きにも連動して動きます。
romaji: katakansetsu ha, tandoku de ugoku hoka, ude no ugoki nimo rendou shite ugoki masu.
meaning: The shoulder joints, as well as moving on their own, also move in conjunction with arm movements.

japanese: リストのデータは、自動集計機能を使って簡単に集計することができます。
romaji: risuto no deeta ha, jidoushuukeikinou o tsukattekantan ni shuukei surukotogadekimasu.
meaning: List data can easily be totalled using the automatic sum function.

japanese: 複数の呼吸器疾患による衰弱のため、彼は先週、指揮者としての仕事を断念する旨の発表を余儀なくされたばかりでした。
romaji: fukusuu no kokyuukishikkan niyoru suijaku notame, karehasenshuu, shikisha toshiteno shigoto o dannen suru mune no happyou o yogina kusaretabakarideshita.
meaning: Weakness brought on by a number of respiratory ailments had forced him just last week to announce that he was giving up his conducting career.

japanese: この文は重複したため削除されました。
romaji: kono bun wa choufuku shitatame sakujo saremashita.
meaning: This sentence has been deleted because it was a duplicate.

japanese: いつまでかかっても全部を説明するのは無理だ。
romaji: itsumadekakattemo zenbu o setsumeisu runoha muri da.
meaning: It would take forever for me to explain everything.

japanese: 本当のことを言うと、全然お金を持ち合わせていません。
romaji: hontou nokotowo iu to, zenzen o kin o mochiawa seteimasen.
meaning: To tell the truth, I have no money with me.

japanese: 以後こんなことはいたしません。
romaji: igo konnakotohaitashimasen.
meaning: I'll never do this again.

japanese: 教育産業に関する情報を掲載したインターネットサイトには以下のようなものがあります。
romaji: kyouikusangyou ni kansu ru jouhou o keisai shita intaanettosaito niha ikano younamonogaarimasu.
meaning: Among the Internet sites that publish information on education related businesses are those given below.

japanese: 例えば、私は、来年進学する大学の単位が実際にもらえる数学の上級クラスにいます。
romaji: tatoeba, watashi ha, rainenshingaku suru daigaku no tan'i ga jissaini moraeru suugaku no joukyuu kurasu niimasu.
meaning: For example, I am in a high-level math class that actually gives me college credits for next year.

japanese: 彼女は仕事のことを尋ねられると、「私の仕事は複雑なので一言では要約できません」と言った。
romaji: kanojo wa shigoto nokotowo tazune rareruto, ( watashi no shigoto wa fukuzatsu nanode hitokoto deha youyaku dekimasen) to itta.
meaning: Asked about her job, she said, "My job is too complicated to sum up in a word."

japanese: アフリカ大陸のどこかへ行くとしたらどこが一番衛生的で安全ですか？
romaji: afurika tairiku nodokokahe iku toshitaradokoga ichibaneiseiteki de anzen desuka ？
meaning: If I was going to the African continent where would be the safest and most sanitary place?

japanese: これは完全燃焼。
romaji: kore wa kanzennenshou.
meaning: This is perfect combustion.

japanese: 死亡事例が19件と全体の20％を超えており、過労死の深刻な実態が浮き彫りになった。
romaji: shiboujirei ga 19 ken to zentai no 20 % o koe teori, karoushi no shinkoku na jittai ga ukibori ninatta.
meaning: With 19 cases of death forming over 20% of the whole, the grave reality of overwork-deaths has been thrown into relief.

japanese: ハロー、問題が解決したよ。以上お知らせでした。
romaji: haroo, mondai ga kaiketsu shitayo. ijou o shirase deshita.
meaning: Hi, I just wanted to let you know that the problem is fixed.

japanese: 私は駅から二百メートル以内に住んでいます。
romaji: watashi wa eki kara nihyaku meetoru inai ni sun deimasu.
meaning: I live within 200 meters of the station.

japanese: ニジェールでは50万人もの子供たちが未だ栄養失調に直面している。
romaji: nijieeru deha 50 bannin mono kodomo tachiga imadaeiyoushitchou ni chokumen shiteiru.
meaning: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.

japanese: パックマンが、ある条件を満たすと追ってくるモンスターを逆襲して食べることができる。
romaji: pakkuman ga, aru jouken o mita suto otsu tekuru monsutaa o gyakushuu shite tabe rukotogadekiru.
meaning: Pac-Man, when a certain condition is reached, can counter attack and eat the monsters chasing him.

japanese: こんな馬鹿なことは言ったことが無い。
romaji: konna baka nakotoha itta kotoga nai.
meaning: That's the stupidest thing I've ever said.

japanese: 非の打ち所がない計画は、窮屈だなあ。
romaji: hi no uchitokoro ganai keikaku ha, kyuukutsu danaa.
meaning: A faultless plan is stifling, isn't it?

japanese: 世界遺産でもある宮島の「厳島神社」は、潮が満ちると神社全体がまるで海に浮かんでいるかのように見えます。その姿は神秘的で、世界中から訪れる観光客を魅了し続けています。
romaji: sekaiisan demoaru miyajima no ( itsukushimajinja) ha, shio ga michi ruto jinjazentai gamarude umi ni uka ndeirukanoyouni mie masu. sono sugata wa shinpiteki de, sekaijuu kara otozure ru kankoukyaku o miryou shi tsuzuke teimasu.
meaning: Also known for being a world heritage site, the Itsukushima Shrine in Miyajima gives the impression that it is floating in the ocean whenever the tides come in. Its mystical appearance continues to attract tourists from all over the world.

japanese: パックマンが、ある条件を満たすと追ってくるモンスターを逆襲して食べることができる。
romaji: pakkuman ga, aru jouken o mita suto otsu tekuru monsutaa o gyakushuu shite tabe rukotogadekiru.
meaning: Pac-Man, when a certain condition is reached, can counter attack and eat the monsters chasing him.

japanese: こんな馬鹿なことは言ったことが無い。
romaji: konna baka nakotoha itta kotoga nai.
meaning: That's the stupidest thing I've ever said.

japanese: 過去は知られているが変えられない。未来は未知だが変えることができる。
romaji: kako wa shira reteiruga kae rarenai. mirai wa michi daga kae rukotogadekiru.
meaning: The past can only be known, not changed. The future can only be changed, not known.

japanese: 輸入車は８％未満しか占めていない。
romaji: yunyuusha wa 8 % miman shika shime teinai.
meaning: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.

japanese: プラモ作りは家でやってくださいよ。ラッカー液の臭い、充満してるじゃないですか。
romaji: puramo tsukuri wa ie deyattekudasaiyo. rakkaa eki no kusai, juuman shiterujanaidesuka.
meaning: Please do your model building at home! The room's full of the smell of lacquer.

japanese: あなたの美意識を満足させるものは何ですか？
romaji: anatano biishiki o manzoku saserumonoha nande suka ？
meaning: What is it that satisfies your aesthetic sense?

japanese: これは無休。
romaji: kore wa mukyuu.
meaning: This is without a holiday, nonstop.

japanese: 無事におつきになったと聞いて安心しました。
romaji: buji niotsukininattato kii te anshinshi mashita.
meaning: I was relieved to hear that you had arrived safely.

japanese: 彼は非常識だ。
romaji: karehahijoushiki da.
meaning: He is devoid of common sense.

japanese: 彼の計画はまだ未定だ。
romaji: kanokeikaku hamada mitei da.
meaning: His plan is still in the air.

japanese: 法律で未成年は喫煙が禁じられている。
romaji: houritsu de miseinen wa kitsuen ga kinji rareteiru.
meaning: The law prohibits minors from smoking.

japanese: 現在、参加を希望する方々がとても多く、状況によって１ヶ月先まで満席になっております。
romaji: genzai, sanka o kibou suru katagata gatotemo ooku, joukyou niyotte 1 ke gatsusaki made manseki ninatteorimasu.
meaning: At present a very great number of people are seeking to participate and, depending on circumstances, up to a month ahead is fully booked.

japanese: ジェイソンは無口な人だったので彼が何かを言うたび驚いていた。
romaji: jieison wa mukuchi na nin dattanode kare ga nanika o iu tabi odoroi teita.
meaning: Jason was a taciturn individual, so it was always a real surprise when he said anything.

japanese: 彼女は無理なお願いをしている。
romaji: kanojo wa muri nao negai woshiteiru.
meaning: She's asking for the impossible.

japanese: 和平会談は再度失敗したが、双方とも相手方に失敗の責任ありと非難した。
romaji: waheikaidan wa saidoshippai shitaga, souhou tomo aitekata ni shippai no sekinin arito hinan shita.
meaning: The peace talks failed again, with both sides blaming the other for the failure.

japanese: 非常口はどこにありますか。
romaji: hijouguchi hadokoniarimasuka.
meaning: Where's the emergency exit?

japanese: 幼なじみが春から大阪の大学に行くらしい。
romaji: you najimiga haru kara oosaka no daigaku ni iku rashii.
meaning: Apparently an old friend of mine is going to a university in Osaka in Spring.

japanese: 彼は４歳と１歳の２児の父親だ。
romaji: kareha 4 toshi to 1 toshi no 2 ji no chichioya da.
meaning: He has two children, aged 4 and 1.

japanese: これは童。
romaji: kore wa warabe dou.
meaning: This is juvenile, child.

japanese: 私は彼らにチケットをもう一枚送ってくれるように頼んだ。
romaji: watashi wa karera ni chiketto womou ichimaiokutsu tekureruyouni tanon da.
meaning: I told them to send me another ticket.

japanese: 幼いながらも、その子供は勇敢だった。
romaji: osanai nagaramo, sono kodomo wa yuukan datta.
meaning: Child as he was, he was brave.

japanese: この世界の教育にはがっかりしてしまう。
romaji: kono sekai no kyouiku nihagakkarishiteshimau.
meaning: Education in this world disappoints me.

japanese: それにしても、幼稚園というところは、季節の行事にとても敏感です。
romaji: sorenishitemo, youchien toiutokoroha, kisetsu no gyouji nitotemo binkan desu.
meaning: Even so, kindergartens are sensitive to seasonal events.

japanese: トムはメアリーの幼友達です。
romaji: tomu wa mearii no youtomodachi desu.
meaning: Tom was Mary's childhood friend.

japanese: 彼は自分の語学力の源として、幼少期からたくさんの競走馬の名前を覚えていたことを挙げた。
romaji: karehajibun no gogakuryoku no gen toshite, youshouki karatakusanno kyousouba no namae o oboe teitakotowo age ta.
meaning: He gave his remembering of race horse names when he was a child as the source of his language ability.

japanese: トムは小児科の先生じゃないよ。
romaji: tomu wa shounika no sensei janaiyo.
meaning: Tom isn't a pediatrician.

japanese: 女性は職場や地域社会でますます重要な責任を担うようになっているので、育児と仕事の両方からストレスを感じている人の数が増えているといわれている。
romaji: josei wa shokuba ya chiikishakai demasumasu juuyounasekinin o ninau youninatteirunode, ikuji to shigoto no ryouhou kara sutoresu o kanji teiru nin no kazu ga fue teirutoiwareteiru.
meaning: Since women are taking on more responsibilities at work and in the community, it is said that the number of women with stress from both child-rearing and work is increasing.

japanese: これは童歌。
romaji: kore wa warabeuta.
meaning: This is children's song, nursery song.

japanese: 彼はこの童話をひとりで書いた。
romaji: kareha kono douwa wohitoride kai ta.
meaning: He wrote this fairy tale by himself.

japanese: 彼女は存命中キリスト教徒であった。
romaji: kanojo wa zonmeichuu kirisuto kyouto deatta.
meaning: She was a Christian in life.

japanese: 言うまでもないことだが捜索は徒労に終わった。
romaji: iu mademonaikotodaga sousaku wa torou ni owa tta.
meaning: It goes without saying, but the search ended in vain.

japanese: よちよち歩きの幼児でもできるのだから家族で楽しんでいただきたい。
romaji: yochiyochi aruki no youji demodekirunodakara kazoku de tanoshi ndeitadakitai.
meaning: Even toddlers can do it, so I'd like you to enjoy yourselves as a family.

japanese: これは乳児。
romaji: kore wa nyuuji.
meaning: This is infant (below 1 years old), suckling baby.

japanese: 児童はみんなその新しい先生が好きになった。
romaji: jidou haminnasono atarashiisensei ga suki ninatta.
meaning: Every child took to the new teacher.

japanese: 童心にかえってもう一度やり直しましょう。
romaji: doushin nikaettemou ichido yari naoshi mashou.
meaning: I will mentally return to childhood and do it all over again.

japanese: 例えば、たばこをぷかぷか吸う先生が、たばこを吸う生徒に注意してもその注意は矛盾しているだろう。
romaji: tatoeba, tabakowopukapuka suusensei ga, tabakowo suuseito ni chuui shitemosono chuui wa mujun shiteirudarou.
meaning: For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.

japanese: 徒歩５分以内に着くはずです。
romaji: toho 5 funinai ni tsuku hazudesu.
meaning: You should get there in five minutes walking.

japanese: 俺は家族全員に見送られながら、旅支度を整えたザックを担ぐ。
romaji: ore wa kazokuzen'in ni miokura renagara, tabishitaku o totonoe ta zakku o katsugu.
meaning: Being seen off by my whole family I shouldered a rucksack, stocked with my trip supplies.

japanese: 惰性に身を任せているがために今のような現在があるんですね。
romaji: dasei ni miwomakase teirugatameni ima noyouna genzai gaarundesune.
meaning: I've ended up in my present state from having indulged myself.

japanese: 内弟子とは師と寝食をともにし、あらゆる武術のノウハウと秘伝を伝える制度だ。
romaji: uchideshi toha shi to shinshoku wotomonishi, arayuru bujutsu no nouhau to hiden o tsutae ru seido da.
meaning: Apprenticeship is a system where you eat, sleep and live with your master and are taught various martial arts know-how and secrets.

japanese: 学校教育の義務的側面は子どもの学習意欲を改善させる様々な研究の多くの取り組みの中ではめったに分析されない。
romaji: gakkoukyouiku no gimutekisokumen wa kodomo no gakushuuiyoku o kaizen saseru samazamanakenkyuu no ooku no torikumi no naka dehamettani bunseki sarenai.
meaning: The mandatory character of schooling is rarely analyzed in the multitude of works dedicated to the study of the various ways to develop within children the desire to learn.

japanese: 俺は家族全員に見送られながら、旅支度を整えたザックを担ぐ。
romaji: ore wa kazokuzen'in ni miokura renagara, tabishitaku o totonoe ta zakku o katsugu.
meaning: Being seen off by my whole family I shouldered a rucksack, stocked with my trip supplies.

japanese: 女性は職場や地域社会でますます重要な責任を担うようになっているので、育児と仕事の両方からストレスを感じている人の数が増えているといわれている。
romaji: josei wa shokuba ya chiikishakai demasumasu juuyounasekinin o ninau youninatteirunode, ikuji to shigoto no ryouhou kara sutoresu o kanji teiru nin no kazu ga fue teirutoiwareteiru.
meaning: Since women are taking on more responsibilities at work and in the community, it is said that the number of women with stress from both child-rearing and work is increasing.

japanese: 娘が卒業した後は自分の好きに任せることにきめた。
romaji: musume ga sotsugyou shita nochi wa jibun no suki ni makase rukotonikimeta.
meaning: We have decided to leave our daughter to herself after she left school.

japanese: これは任す。
romaji: kore wa makasu.
meaning: This is to entrust, to leave to a person.

japanese: 一生懸命作られたゲームには、一生懸命に取り組むのが礼儀なんだよ？ポーズボタンなんて押したらゲームに失礼だもん。
romaji: isshoukenmeitsukura reta geemu niha, isshoukenmei ni torikumu noga reigi nandayo ？ poozubotan nante oshi tara geemu ni shitsurei damon.
meaning: It's only manners to tackle all out a game that they have gone all out in creating. Pressing the pause button is just rude!

japanese: 学校教育の義務的側面は子どもの学習意欲を改善させる様々な研究の多くの取り組みの中ではめったに分析されない。
romaji: gakkoukyouiku no gimutekisokumen wa kodomo no gakushuuiyoku o kaizen saseru samazamanakenkyuu no ooku no torikumi no naka dehamettani bunseki sarenai.
meaning: The mandatory character of schooling is rarely analyzed in the multitude of works dedicated to the study of the various ways to develop within children the desire to learn.

japanese: スミス先生が学校を辞めたら、誰が私たちのクラスを担当するのだろう。
romaji: sumisu sensei ga gakkou o yame tara, daregawatashitachi no kurasu o tantou surunodarou.
meaning: Who will be in charge of our class when Miss Smith leaves school?

japanese: 彼女はその会社を辞任するよう求められた。
romaji: kanojo hasono kaisha o jinin suruyou motome rareta.
meaning: She was required to step down in the office.

japanese: シンガポールの医師は殆どの場合皆お互いを知っている、というのが日本と異なります。
romaji: shingapooru no ishi wa hotondo no baaimina o tagai o shitte iru, toiunoga nippon to kotona rimasu.
meaning: What's different from Japan is that the doctors of Singapore generally all know each other.

japanese: 彼は恩師にまったく感謝していなかった。
romaji: karehaonshi nimattaku kanshashi teinakatta.
meaning: He was far from thankful to his former teacher.

japanese: これは組織図。
romaji: kore wa soshikizu.
meaning: This is organization chart.

japanese: ケアプランの作成等の居宅介護支援事業については、介護保険により負担されます。
romaji: keapuran no sakuseinado no kyotakukaigoshienjigyou nitsuiteha, kaigohoken niyori futan saremasu.
meaning: Nursing insurance covers drawing up the care plan and other work supporting home nursing.

japanese: 母は担任の先生と会う予定である。
romaji: haha wa tannin no sensei to auyotei dearu.
meaning: My mother is to meet with my homeroom teacher tomorrow.

japanese: 授業の終わり近くになると、教師が一言も「静かにしなさい」「座りなさい！」と言わないにもかかわらず、自然と子どもたちは自分の席に戻り静かになる。
romaji: jugyou no owarichikaku ninaruto, kyoushi ga hitokoto mo ( shizuka nishinasai) ( suwari nasai!) to iwa nainimokakawarazu, shizen to kodomo tachiha jibun no seki ni modorishizuka ninaru.
meaning: As the lesson comes to an end, even if the teacher doesn't say "be quiet" or "sit down," the children naturally return to their seats and quieten down.

japanese: 日本ではね、調理師は特別な試験を受けないとフグを捌けないんだ。
romaji: nippon dehane, chourishi wa tokubetsu na shiken o uke naito fugu o sabake nainda.
meaning: In Japan, chefs must take a special exam to be allowed to prepare pufferfish.

japanese: ノルディックコンバインドは、スキージャンプとクロスカントリースキーの2つの競技を組み合わせて行われる。
romaji: norudikkukonbaindo ha, sukiijanpu to kurosukantoriisukii no 2 tsuno kyougi o kumiawase te okonawa reru.
meaning: Nordic Combined is held as a combination of two events, ski-jump and cross-country ski.

japanese: 来週になると、何十万人もの人がその番組を見ているだろう。
romaji: raishuu ninaruto, nanjuumannin mono nin gasono bangumi o mite irudarou.
meaning: Next week, millions of people will be watching the TV program.

japanese: 師走になりました。
romaji: shiwasu ninarimashita.
meaning: It is now December.

japanese: 中央には机が据えられていて、赤い革張りの回転椅子がそえてあった。
romaji: chuuou niha tsukue ga sue rareteite, akaikawahari no kaiten'isu gasoeteatta.
meaning: A desk stood in the centre, with a red leather swivel chair.

japanese: そういえば、電車の中で隣に座ったほろ酔いのおっさんに、自分の俳句を見て欲しいと言われたことがある。
romaji: souieba, densha no naka de tonari ni suwatsu tahoro yoi noossanni, jibun no haiku o mitehoshii to iwa retakotogaaru.
meaning: Now that I think of it, I've been asked to look at a haiku he'd written by the tipsy bloke sitting next to me on the train.

japanese: ベニヤ板で十分だとのこと、教えられたとおりベニヤ板で作ることにします。
romaji: beniya ita de juubun datonokoto, oshie raretatoori beniya ita de tsukuru kotonishimasu.
meaning: Having been informed that plywood is sufficient, I will make it with plywood, as instructed.

japanese: 彼は筆まめだ。
romaji: karehafude mameda.
meaning: He is a good correspondent.

japanese: 「どうぞ、座って下さい」と言われてから、椅子に座る。
romaji: ( douzo, suwatsu te kudasai) to iwa retekara, isu ni suwaru.
meaning: After being told, "Please, sit down," I sit in the chair.

japanese: そういえば、電車の中で隣に座ったほろ酔いのおっさんに、自分の俳句を見て欲しいと言われたことがある。
romaji: souieba, densha no naka de tonari ni suwatsu tahoro yoi noossanni, jibun no haiku o mitehoshii to iwa retakotogaaru.
meaning: Now that I think of it, I've been asked to look at a haiku he'd written by the tipsy bloke sitting next to me on the train.

japanese: ベニヤ板で十分だとのこと、教えられたとおりベニヤ板で作ることにします。
romaji: beniya ita de juubun datonokoto, oshie raretatoori beniya ita de tsukuru kotonishimasu.
meaning: Having been informed that plywood is sufficient, I will make it with plywood, as instructed.

japanese: これは学習机。
romaji: kore wa gakushuuzukue.
meaning: This is writing desk.

japanese: 古代の天文学者は、星座を見つけ、名前をつけた。
romaji: kodai no tenmongakusha ha, seiza o mitsu ke, namae wotsuketa.
meaning: Ancient astronomers noticed constellations and gave them names.

japanese: あのー、先生？黒板に書いてあるの、指数関数じゃなくて三角関数ですけど・・・。
romaji: anoo, sensei ？ kokuban ni kai tearuno, shisuukansuu janakute sankakukansuu desukedo ・・・.
meaning: Er, Sir? What's written on the blackboard isn't an exponential function but a trigonometric one ...

japanese: おじいちゃんは昔、板前さんでした。
romaji: ojiichanha mukashi, itamae sandeshita.
meaning: My grandfather used to be a chef.

japanese: これは鉛板。
romaji: kore wa enban.
meaning: This is lead plate.

japanese: 万年筆を持っていますか。
romaji: mannenhitsu o motsu teimasuka.
meaning: Do you have a fountain pen with you?

japanese: これは板書。
romaji: kore wa bansho.
meaning: This is writing on a blackboard.

japanese: さしずめ忍耐力に自信のない筆者などは、２，３時間で音をあげてしまう作業である。
romaji: sashizume nintairyoku ni jishin nonai hissha nadoha, 2, 3 jikan de oto woageteshimau sagyou dearu.
meaning: In fact, an artist lacking in confidence and fortitude would lose focus after 2 or 3 hours.

japanese: 学生たちはアンフェアな筆記試験に抗議した。
romaji: gakusei tachiha anfea na hikkishiken ni kougi shita.
meaning: The students protested against the unfair exam.

japanese: 君の言っていることは机上の空論にすぎないよ。
romaji: kun no itte irukotoha kijou no kuuron nisuginaiyo.
meaning: What you are saying is nothing but building a castle in the air.

japanese: これは板木 oder 版木。
romaji: kore wa hangi.
meaning: This is (printing) block, woodcut.

japanese: ちょっと顔を貸してくれませんか。
romaji: chotto kao o kashi tekuremasenka.
meaning: Can I have a few words with you?

japanese: 赤鉛筆を忘れた子どもには、きちんと借りに来させた。
romaji: akaenpitsu o wasure ta kodomo niha, kichinto kari ni kisa seta.
meaning: I made sure that children who'd forgotten their red pencil came to borrow one.

japanese: 私たちはもう終わったわ。指輪を返して！
romaji: watashitachi hamou owa ttawa. yubiwa o kaeshi te!
meaning: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!

japanese: ポール、8冊までなら借りられるからね。
romaji: pooru, 8 satsu madenara kari rarerukarane.
meaning: Paul, we can borrow up to 8 books.

japanese: 力を貸すことは、ほとんど出来ないと思ってください。
romaji: chikara o kasu kotoha, hotondo dekina ito omotte kudasai.
meaning: You can hardly expect me to help you.

japanese: 彼からお金を借りるのはよくない。
romaji: kare karao kin o kari runohayokunai.
meaning: It is not good to borrow money from him.

japanese: 彼は私に後ろを振り返るなと言った。
romaji: karehawatashi ni ushiro o furikaeru nato itta.
meaning: He told me not to look behind.

japanese: 個体発生は系統発生を繰り返す。
romaji: kotaihassei wa keitouhassei o kurikaesu.
meaning: Ontogeny recapitulates phylogeny.

japanese: 貸借の期間が短ければ交友期間は長い。
romaji: taishaku no kikan ga mijikake reba kouyuukikan wa nagai.
meaning: Short accounts make long friends.

japanese: 彼は決して物の貸し借りはしない。
romaji: karehakesshitemono no kashikari hashinai.
meaning: He never borrows nor lends things.

japanese: 聞きましたわよ。ご両親が借金を残して蒸発したそうですわね。
romaji: kiki mashitawayo. go ryoushin ga shakkin o nokoshi te jouhatsu shitasoudesuwane.
meaning: I've heard about it. Your parents disappeared, running out on their debt didn't they?

japanese: 彼の手紙に返信を出すべきだったのに。
romaji: kanotegami ni henshin o dasu bekidattanoni.
meaning: You should have replied to his letter.

japanese: これは別冊。
romaji: kore wa bessatsu.
meaning: This is seperate volume, extra issue, supplement, additional volume, supplementary volume.

japanese: これは貸し切る。
romaji: kore wa kashikiru.
meaning: This is to reserve, to charter.

japanese: これは借地。
romaji: kore wa shakuchi.
meaning: This is leased land.

japanese: 個体発生は系統発生を繰り返す。
romaji: kotaihassei wa keitouhassei o kurikaesu.
meaning: Ontogeny recapitulates phylogeny.

japanese: こいつ、さっきまで俺の相棒だったのに、もう寝返りやがった。
romaji: koitsu, sakkimade ore no aibou dattanoni, mou negaeri yagatta.
meaning: This rat, up until just now he was my partner and now he's gone and turned on me.

japanese: 返事を待つアリスに向けられたのは突然の咆哮。それは耳を貫かんばかりに鋭く、天に届かんばかりに大きく響くものでした。
romaji: henji o matsu arisu ni muke raretanoha totsuzen no houkou. soreha mimi o tsuranuka nbakarini surudoku, ten ni todoka nbakarini ookikuhibiku monodeshita.
meaning: What Alice, waiting for a reply, was faced with was a sudden howl. It was a resounding noise, sharp as to burst her ear drums, loud as to reach unto the heavens.

japanese: 返品お断り。
romaji: henpin o kotowari.
meaning: No merchandise can be returned.

japanese: 彼は講義を小冊子で補った。
romaji: karehakougi o shousasshi de oginatsu ta.
meaning: He supplemented his lecture with a booklet.

japanese: これは短冊。
romaji: kore wa tanzaku.
meaning: This is long, narrow card on which Japanese poems are written (vertically), strip of paper.

japanese: ぎょうざの具のあまりは？餃子を家で作りましたが、皮が少なかったせいか、具が少し余ってしまいました。
romaji: gyouzano gu noamariha ？ gyouza o ie de tsukuri mashitaga, kawa ga sukunaka ttaseika, gu ga sukoshiamatsu teshimaimashita.
meaning: Gyoza stuffing? I made some gyoza at home but, possibly because I didn't have enough dough, I had some of the filling left over.

japanese: 輸送中に箱が拉げて中身がとび出した。
romaji: yusouchuu ni hako ga hisage te nakami gatobi dashi ta.
meaning: The box was crushed during transport and the contents flew out.

japanese: 輸送中に箱が拉げて中身がとび出した。
romaji: yusouchuu ni hako ga hisage te nakami gatobi dashi ta.
meaning: The box was crushed during transport and the contents flew out.

japanese: 足を棒にして探しても、気に入るものがありませんでした。
romaji: ashi o bou nishite sagashi temo, kiniiru monogaarimasendeshita.
meaning: Even walking till my legs turned to lead I couldn't find one that I liked.

japanese: 「背が伸びて入らないわよね」「そう、断じて太ったわけではない！」「成長したという便利な言葉は我々の切り札」
romaji: ( seganobi te ira naiwayone) ( sou, danji te futotsu tawakedehanai!) ( seichoushi tatoiu benri na kotoba wa wareware no kirifuda)
meaning: "We've got taller so they don't fit." "Right, it's certainly not that we've got fat!" "The useful phrase 'grown up' is our trump card."

japanese: 夏には草がよく伸びる。
romaji: natsu niha kusa gayoku nobi ru.
meaning: Grass is luxuriant in summer.

japanese: 暗闇の中、俺は遠ざかる後姿に必死に手を伸ばす。
romaji: kurayami no naka, ore wa tooza karu ushirosugata ni hisshi ni te o noba su.
meaning: In the darkness, I frantically reach out towards the receding figure.

japanese: これは伸べる auch 延べる。
romaji: kore wa noberu.
meaning: This is to lay out (a futon), to make (bed), to spread out, to stretch, to widen, to postpone, to extend.

japanese: 自転車は都会の環境を破壊することなく資源利用を持続することのできる道具である。
romaji: jitensha wa tokai no kankyou o hakai surukotonaku shigenriyou o jizoku surukotonodekiru dougu dearu.
meaning: Bicycles are tools for urban sustainability.

japanese: これは文具店。
romaji: kore wa bunguten.
meaning: This is stationery store, stationery shop, stationer's.

japanese: これは具体。
romaji: kore wa   gutai.
meaning: This is concrete, tangible, material.

japanese: 空き箱あったよ。
romaji: akihako attayo.
meaning: I found an empty box.

japanese: これは屈伸。
romaji: kore wa kusshin.
meaning: This is elasticity.

japanese: 母親の古い家具を売り払わなければならないのは悲しい。
romaji: hahaoya no furuikagu o uriharawa nakerebanaranainoha kanashii.
meaning: It is sad to have to part with my mother's old furniture.

japanese: そして、この遊具には滑り台のデッキに上がる方法がもう一つあります。
romaji: soshite, kono yuugu niha suberidai no dekki ni aga ru houhou gamou hitotsu arimasu.
meaning: And there is one more method of climbing up to the slide deck.

japanese: 彼は本箱を作るために材木を少し買っている。
romaji: karehahonbako o tsukuru tameni zaimoku o sukoshikatsu teiru.
meaning: He is buying some wood so that he can make a bookcase.

japanese: 体操競技の中では、鉄棒の大車輪が好きです。
romaji: taisoukyougi no naka deha, tetsubou no daisharin ga suki desu.
meaning: I like to see a gymnast do the giant swing on the high bar.

japanese: しかし物々交換制は、人々の要求が一致することは希であったので、非常に不満足な制度だった。
romaji: shikashi butsubutsukoukansei ha, hitobito no youkyuu ga itchi surukotoha mare deattanode, hijounifumanzoku na seido datta.
meaning: Barter, however, was a very unsatisfactory system because people's needs seldom matched exactly.

japanese: そこで私たちを待っている幸福が、私たちが望むような幸福ではないかもしれない。
romaji: sokode watashitachi o matsu teiru koufuku ga, watashitachi ga nozomu youna koufuku dehanaikamoshirenai.
meaning: It may be that the happiness awaiting us is not at all the sort of happiness we would want.

japanese: 恐い話が聞きたいなら、数週間前に私が見た夢のことを話してあげるよ。
romaji: kowaihanashi ga kiki tainara, suushuukanmae ni watashi ga mitayume nokotowo hanashi teageruyo.
meaning: If you want to hear a scary story, I'll tell you about a dream I had a few weeks ago.

japanese: 空腹はメンタル的に良くない。
romaji: kuufuku wa mentaru tekiniyoku nai.
meaning: An empty stomach doesn't help on the mental front.

japanese: そこで私たちを待っている幸福が、私たちが望むような幸福ではないかもしれない。
romaji: sokode watashitachi o matsu teiru koufuku ga, watashitachi ga nozomu youna koufuku dehanaikamoshirenai.
meaning: It may be that the happiness awaiting us is not at all the sort of happiness we would want.

japanese: 空腹はメンタル的に良くない。
romaji: kuufuku wa mentaru tekiniyoku nai.
meaning: An empty stomach doesn't help on the mental front.

japanese: 空腹はメンタル的に良くない。
romaji: kuufuku wa mentaru tekiniyoku nai.
meaning: An empty stomach doesn't help on the mental front.

japanese: これは希少な。
romaji: kore wa kishouna.
meaning: This is scarce, rare.

japanese: 英日の翻訳と日英の翻訳では、英日の翻訳を希望する人のほうが多いようです。
romaji: einichi no honyaku to nichiei no honyaku deha, einichi no honyaku o kibou suru nin nohouga ooi youdesu.
meaning: Between E→J translations and J→E, it appears that more people want English-Japanese translations.

japanese: 望遠鏡を通してみると、惑星はまったく新たな様相を呈する。
romaji: bouenkyou o toushi temiruto, wakusei hamattaku arata na yousou o teisu ru.
meaning: Seen through a telescope, the planets take on a completely new appearance.

japanese: 彼女の悩ましげな姿を見て、彼はすっかり夢中になってしまいました。
romaji: kanojo no nayama shigena sugata o mite, kareha sukkari muchuu ninatteshimaimashita.
meaning: After seeing her provocative body, he became obsessed with her.

japanese: これは夢見る。
romaji: kore wa yumemiru.
meaning: This is to dream (of).

japanese: これは全国的な。
romaji: kore wa zenkokutekina.
meaning: This is nation-wide.

japanese: 多くの人が目的なく人生を漂う。
romaji: ooku no nin ga mokuteki naku jinsei o tadayou.
meaning: Many people drift through life without a purpose.

japanese: これは望遠。
romaji: kore wa bouen.
meaning: This is seeing at a distance.

japanese: 彼らは互いに失望を感じている。
romaji: karera wa tagainishitsubou o kanji teiru.
meaning: They are disappointed with each other.

japanese: それぞれの筋肉が完璧なチームワークを示す。

meaning: Each muscle shows perfect teamwork.

japanese: その坂道を下ろう。
romaji: sono sakamichi o kudaro u.
meaning: Let's descend the slope.

japanese: これは急坂。
romaji: kore wa kyuuhan.
meaning: This is steep slope, steep gradient.

japanese: 湿気の多い気候はその半島の特色です。
romaji: shikke no ooikikou hasono hanshima no tokushoku desu.
meaning: A humid climate is characteristic of the peninsula.

japanese: パプアニューギニア近くのカーテレット諸島では、海水が家のまわりにうち寄せているので、すでに家を離れなければならなくなった人たちがいる。
romaji: papuanyuuginia chikaku no kaateretto shoshima deha, kaisui ga ie nomawariniuchi yose teirunode, sudeni ie o hanare nakerebanaranakunatta nin tachigairu.
meaning: In the Carteret Islands, near Papua New Guinea, some people have already had to leave their homes because the seawater is washing around their houses.

japanese: 彼は海軍を退役してみると陸上の生活に適応するのが難しいことがわかった。
romaji: karehakaigun o taieki shitemiruto rikujou no seikatsu ni tekiou surunoga muzukashii kotogawakatta.
meaning: When he left the navy, he found it hard to adjust to life ashore.

japanese: アフリカ大陸のどこかへ行くとしたらどこが一番衛生的で安全ですか？
romaji: afurika tairiku nodokokahe iku toshitaradokoga ichibaneiseiteki de anzen desuka ？
meaning: If I was going to the African continent where would be the safest and most sanitary place?

japanese: 川岸で数人の男が糸を垂れている。
romaji: kawagishi de suunin no otoko ga ito o tare teiru.
meaning: Several men are fishing from the riverbank.

japanese: 日本に住む外国人も、日本の法律に準じて裁かれる。
romaji: nippon ni sumugaikokujin mo, nippon no houritsu ni junji te sabaka reru.
meaning: Foreigners who live in Japan are judged according to Japanese laws.

japanese: 来る途中、お店に寄って食材を買って来たんです。備えあれば憂いなし、です。
romaji: kurutochuu, o mise ni yotsu te shokuzai o katsu te kita ndesu. sonae areba urei nashi, desu.
meaning: On the way we dropped in at the shops and bought foodstuffs. They say well prepared means no worries.

japanese: 私達は火災に備えるべきだ。
romaji: watashitachi wa kasai ni sonae rubekida.
meaning: We should provide against fires.

japanese: これは備わる。
romaji: kore wa sonawaru.
meaning: This is to be furnished with, to be provided with, to be equipped with, to be possessed of, to be endowed with, to be gifted with, to be among, to be one of.

japanese: こんな時は、迎え酒に限ります。
romaji: konna toki ha, mukaesake ni kagiri masu.
meaning: In times like this, there's nothing like a hair of the dog.

japanese: 明日の晩五人のお客を迎えることになっている。
romaji: ashita no bangonin noo kyaku o mukae rukotoninatteiru.
meaning: We are to take in five guests tomorrow evening.

japanese: 彼は時々変です。
romaji: karehatokidokihende su.
meaning: Sometimes he can be a strange guy.

japanese: 彼は時々変です。
romaji: karehatokidokihende su.
meaning: Sometimes he can be a strange guy.

japanese: 野菜の値段は日々変わる。
romaji: yasai no nedan wa hibikawa ru.
meaning: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.

japanese: 世界を変えるのは情報ではなくコミュニケーションだ。
romaji: sekai o kae runoha jouhou dehanaku komyunikeeshon da.
meaning: What changes the world is communication, not information.

japanese: 消息筋によると、○○社は東証一部への上場を準備している。
romaji: shousokusuji niyoruto, ○ ○ sha wa toushouichibu heno joujou o junbi shiteiru.
meaning: According to informed sources, ____ Ltd. is preparing for the move up to the first section of the Tokyo Stock exchange.

japanese: 日本の自動車メーカーは新しい設備に大きな投資をしている。
romaji: nippon no jidousha meekaa wa atarashiisetsubi ni ooki na toushi woshiteiru.
meaning: Japanese automakers are investing heavily in new plant and equipment.

japanese: 列車を降りるとすぐに、彼はいとこの出迎えを受けた。
romaji: ressha o ori rutosuguni, kareha itokono demukae o uke ta.
meaning: On getting off the train, he was met by his cousin.

japanese: 彼女の歓迎会を行った。
romaji: kanojo no kangeikai o itta.
meaning: We had a welcome party for her.

japanese: 職場・仕事の変化で、かなりストレスがたまっているのもある。
romaji: shokuba ・ shigoto no henka de, kanari sutoresu gatamatteirunomoaru.
meaning: I've also built up a lot of stress from the change in job and work-place.

japanese: 1998年のワールドカップでは、ブラジルは準優勝に終わった。
romaji: 1998 nen no waarudokappu deha, burajiru wa junyuushou ni owa tta.
meaning: Brazil finished runners-up in the 1998 World Cup.

japanese: 予備の毛布をください。
romaji: yobi no moufu wokudasai.
meaning: I need an extra blanket.

japanese: この空港は新千歳空港ほど便数が多くないので、送迎デッキから見ても最初は飛行機がいませんでした。
romaji: kono kuukou wa shinchitosekuukou hodo binsuu ga ooku nainode, sougei dekki kara mite mo saisho wa hikouki gaimasendeshita.
meaning: This airport doesn't have as many flights as New Chitose Airport and even looking from the observation deck at first there were no planes.

japanese: 国王はいつも自分を褒めるおべっか使いにうんざりしていたので彼らを遠くへ飛ばした。
romaji: kokuou haitsumo jibun o home ruobekka tsukai niunzarishiteitanode karera o tooku e toba shita.
meaning: The king was tired of his sycophants always praising him, so he sent them away.

japanese: それからの日々は、飛ぶように過ぎた。
romaji: sorekarano hibi ha, tobu youni sugi ta.
meaning: The days after that flew past.

japanese: 悩みを笑い飛ばすとはいかにも彼らしい。
romaji: nayami o waraitoba sutohaikanimo karera shii.
meaning: Laughing troubles away is characteristic of him.

japanese: 馬鹿が移るまえにそのような宗教に関わらんほうがいい。
romaji: baka ga utsuru maenisonoyouna shuukyou ni kakawa ranhougaii.
meaning: You should stay away from cults like that before you turn into a moron.

japanese: 馬鹿が移るまえにそのような宗教に関わらんほうがいい。
romaji: baka ga utsuru maenisonoyouna shuukyou ni kakawa ranhougaii.
meaning: You should stay away from cults like that before you turn into a moron.

japanese: 風邪を人に移すと治るって本当？
romaji: kaze o nin ni utsusu to naoru tte hontou ？
meaning: Is it true that you recover from colds when you give them to someone else?

japanese: 富士山に登った後で一首浮かんだ。
romaji: fujisan ni nobotsu ta atodeisshuuka nda.
meaning: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.

japanese: 城の創建は１１世紀にさかのぼると伝えられる。
romaji: shiro no souken wa 1 1 seiki nisakanoboruto tsutae rareru.
meaning: It is said that the castle dates back to the 11th century.

japanese: やっぱり駅まで行くのは疲れるから、泊まっているホテルまで来いってことだ。まったく身勝手な女だよ。
romaji: yappari eki made iku noha tsukare rukara, toma tteiru hoteru made koi ttekotoda. mattaku migatte na onna dayo.
meaning: It was to say that going to the station was too much of a bother after all so I should come to the hotel she's staying at. Good grief, what a selfish woman!

japanese: やっぱり駅まで行くのは疲れるから、泊まっているホテルまで来いってことだ。まったく身勝手な女だよ。
romaji: yappari eki made iku noha tsukare rukara, toma tteiru hoteru made koi ttekotoda. mattaku migatte na onna dayo.
meaning: It was to say that going to the station was too much of a bother after all so I should come to the hotel she's staying at. Good grief, what a selfish woman!

japanese: 夜はこのホテルに泊まるつもりです。
romaji: yoru hakono hoteru ni toma rutsumoridesu.
meaning: I'm going to stop at this hotel for the night.

japanese: 一晩彼を泊めることができる。
romaji: hitobankare o tome rukotogadekiru.
meaning: We can accommodate him for the night.

japanese: 飛行機が乱気流に近付いていたため操縦士は乗客にシートベルトを締めるよう呼びかけた。
romaji: hikouki ga rankiryuu ni chikazui teitatame soujuushi wa joukyaku ni shiitoberuto o shime ruyou yobi kaketa.
meaning: As the plane was approaching turbulence, the pilot asked the passengers aboard the plane to fasten their seat belts.

japanese: 彼女の一家はブラジルへ移住して行った。
romaji: kanojo no ikka wa burajiru e ijuu shite itta.
meaning: Her family moved to Brazil.

japanese: 移住者は大陸から日本海を渡ってきた。
romaji: ijuusha wa tairiku kara nihonkai o watatsu tekita.
meaning: Migrants from the continent crossed the Japan sea.

japanese: 登山道に空き缶やゴミを捨てるのはやめてほしい。
romaji: tozandou ni akikan ya gomi o sute runohayametehoshii.
meaning: I wish people would stop throwing away empty cans and other trash along the path up the mountain.

japanese: 椎間板ヘルニアは背骨の間にある椎間板という軟骨が飛び出すものです。
romaji: tsuikanban herunia wa sebone no mani aru tsuikanban toiu nankotsu ga tobidasu monodesu.
meaning: Disk herniation is when cartilage, called 'intervertebral disk' and found between each vertebra, slips out.

japanese: これから火葬場へ移動しますので、小川様と君は車へ。
romaji: korekara kasouba e idou shimasunode, ogawasama to kun wa kuruma he.
meaning: We are now going to move to the crematorium so if Mr. Ogawa and you would enter the car ...

japanese: 画像をクリックすると次ページへ移ります！
romaji: gazou o kurikku suruto jipeeji e utsuri masu!
meaning: Click the picture to go to the next page!

japanese: 新しいビルへの移転にわくわくしてます。
romaji: atarashii biru heno iten niwakuwakushitemasu.
meaning: We are excited about the move to the new building.

japanese: 彼は登山になれている。
romaji: karehatozan ninareteiru.
meaning: He's accustomed to climbing mountains.

japanese: 彼はホテルに電話で宿泊を頼んだ。
romaji: kareha hoteru ni denwa de shukuhaku o tanon da.
meaning: He called a hotel for accommodations.

japanese: 翌朝早くサーカス団は次の町へ出発した。
romaji: yokuchouhayaku saakasu dan wa tsuginomachi e shuppatsu shita.
meaning: Early the next morning, the circus left for the next town.

japanese: 料理人は彼の信じられない程の食欲にとても驚いた。
romaji: ryourinin wa kanoshinji rarenai hodo no shokuyoku nitotemo odoroi ta.
meaning: The cook was astonished at his incredible appetite.

japanese: インコやオウムと仲良く楽しく健やかに暮らすために、飼鳥の行動学やペットロスについて考える。
romaji: inko ya oumu to nakayokutanoshikusukoyaka ni kura sutameni, kaidori no koudougaku ya pettorosu nitsuite kangae ru.
meaning: In order to live happily and healthily with parakeets or parrots, you should understand the science of animal behavior for domesticated birds, and consider the emotional effect of eventually losing them.

japanese: 彼らはミズーリ州に植民する計画を立てている。
romaji: karera wa mizuuri shuu ni shokumin suru keikaku o tate teiru.
meaning: They are planning to settle Missouri.

japanese: 登場する人物、団体および地名は実在するものと一切関係ありません。
romaji: toujou suru jinbutsu, dantai oyobi chimei wa jitsuzai surumonoto issaikankei arimasen.
meaning: There is no relation between characters appearing, organisations and places to those that really exist.

japanese: どんな組織であれ、内部の融和と団結はその組織の成敗を決める重要な要素だ。
romaji: donna soshiki deare, naibu no yuuwa to danketsu hasono soshiki no seibai o kime ru juuyounayouso da.
meaning: For any type of organisation, internal harmony and unity are important factors in deciding its success or failure.

japanese: 楽団は新しい指揮者の指揮ですばらしい演奏をした。
romaji: gakudan wa atarashiishikisha no shiki desubarashii ensou woshita.
meaning: The band played marvellously under the baton of a new conductor.

japanese: 布団をはがされた。
romaji: futon wohagasareta.
meaning: My futon was peeled away.

japanese: 部長の都合が悪くなってしまったので、飲み会の日程は仕切り直しだね。
romaji: buchou no tsugou ga waruku natteshimattanode, nomikai no nittei wa shikirinaoshi dane.
meaning: We'll have to organize the drinking party all over again as the section chief can't make it now.

japanese: 先程、どういうわけかマイクが入りませんでした。
romaji: sakihodo, douiuwakeka maiku ga iri masendeshita.
meaning: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.

japanese: 時間を厳守することは、欧米では当然のことと考えられている。
romaji: jikan o genshu surukotoha, oubei deha touzen nokototo kangae rareteiru.
meaning: Punctuality is thought to be a matter of course in Europe and America.

japanese: それを皮切りとして欧州の詩や文学を多数紹介するようになりました。
romaji: sorewo kawakiri ritoshite oushuu no shi ya bungaku o tasuushoukai suruyouninarimashita.
meaning: With that as a start many European poems and much literature came to be introduced.

japanese: これは三角州。
romaji: kore wa sankakusu.
meaning: This is river delta.

japanese: 夜の闇の中に団地が並んでいた。
romaji: yoru no yami no nakanidanchi ga naran deita.
meaning: The apartment buildings stood side by side in the darkness of the night.

japanese: 「ところで神社を知っていますか？」「軽く触れる程度には。信仰対象となった存在、いわゆるところの神格を祭る礼拝施設ね」
romaji: ( tokorode jinja o shitte imasuka ？) ( karukufureruteido niha. shinkoutaishou tonatta sonzai, iwayurutokorono shinkaku o matsurureihaishisetsu ne)
meaning: "By the way, do you know what a Shinto shrine is?" "I've a little bit of knowledge on the subject. It's a religious facility where that which is the object of worship, that called the genius loci, is enshrined."

japanese: これは欧米化。
romaji: kore wa oubeika.
meaning: This is westernization.

japanese: 北海道は本州の北にある。
romaji: hokkaidou wa honshuu no kita niaru.
meaning: Hokkaido is to the north of Honshu.

japanese: 北海道は九州と比べるととても寒い。
romaji: hokkaidou wa kyuushuu to kurabe rutototemo samui.
meaning: Hokkaido is very cold compared with Kyushu.

japanese: 彼女は今、歌舞伎を観ているところだ。
romaji: kanojo wa ima, kabuki o mite irutokoroda.
meaning: She is seeing a Kabuki play now.

japanese: むろん、舟は何百艘も水面を動きまわっているが、どれでもいいというわけにはいかない。
romaji: muron, fune wa nanbyakusou mo suimen o ugoki mawatteiruga, doredemoiitoiuwakenihaikanai.
meaning: Of course there were several hundred boats moving around on the water but not just any old one would do.

japanese: むろん、舟は何百艘も水面を動きまわっているが、どれでもいいというわけにはいかない。
romaji: muron, fune wa nanbyakusou mo suimen o ugoki mawatteiruga, doredemoiitoiuwakenihaikanai.
meaning: Of course there were several hundred boats moving around on the water but not just any old one would do.

japanese: 老犬に新しい芸は仕込めない。
romaji: rouken ni atarashiigei wa shikome nai.
meaning: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.

japanese: 二輪車が倒れずに走行するのには前輪が大きな役割を演じています。
romaji: nirinsha ga taore zuni soukou surunoniha zenrin ga ooki na yakuwari o enji teimasu.
meaning: The front wheel plays an important role in two-wheeled vehicles moving without falling over.

japanese: ナイアガラの滝は世界有数の観光地として名高い。
romaji: naiagara no taki wa sekaiyuusuu no kankouchi toshite nadakai.
meaning: The Niagara Falls are famous as a world leading tourist resort.

japanese: これは観光地な。
romaji: kore wa shukantekina.
meaning: This is subjective.

japanese: 予想以上に多くの観客が来ていました。
romaji: yosouijou ni ooku no kankyaku ga kite imashita.
meaning: There were more spectators than I had expected.

japanese: 父は園芸の基本を教えてくれた。
romaji: chichi wa engei no kihon o oshie tekureta.
meaning: My father taught me the nuts and bolts of gardening.

japanese: ルネッサンス時代、ベニスの芸術は全盛期を迎えていました。
romaji: runessansu jidai, benisu no geijutsu wa zenseiki o mukae teimashita.
meaning: Art was in its golden age in Venice during the Renaissance.

japanese: これは学芸会。
romaji: kore wa gakugeikai.
meaning: This is school arts festival.

japanese: 君が演説をして誰も来なかったらどうするの？
romaji: kun ga enzetsu woshite daremokona kattaradousuruno ？
meaning: What if you gave a speech and nobody came?

japanese: 彼女はジュリエットの役を演じるのに適任だ。
romaji: kanojo wa jurietto no yaku o enji runoni tekinin da.
meaning: She is a natural to play the part of Juliet.

japanese: 僕が君と一緒に住んだことは君の人生観に影響を与えたと思う。
romaji: boku ga kun to isshonisun dakotoha kun no jinseikan ni eikyou o atae tato omou.
meaning: I think my living with you has influenced your way of living.

japanese: 太陽の黒点を観察しよう。
romaji: taiyou no kokuten o kansatsu shiyou.
meaning: Let's observe sunspots.

japanese: 毎年１０月が観光客の数が最高になるそうだ。
romaji: maitoshi 1 0 gatsu ga kankoukyaku no kazu ga saikou ninarusouda.
meaning: They say that every year the number of tourists is greatest in October.

japanese: これは文芸。
romaji: kore wa bungei.
meaning: This is literature, art and literature, belles-lettres.

japanese: これは伝統芸能。
romaji: kore wa dentougeinou.
meaning: This is traditional art, traditional performance art.

japanese: 胸をどきどきさせて開演を待った。
romaji: mune wodokidokisasete kaien o matsu ta.
meaning: I waited for the curtain to rise with my heart beating in excitement.

japanese: どうやら、さっきのは演技ではなく、素だったらしい。
romaji: douyara, sakkinoha engi dehanaku, moto dattarashii.
meaning: It seems like that she wasn't acting back then; they were her real feelings.

romaji: hotoke no kao mo sando.
meaning: You can only go so far.

japanese: 仏の顔も三度。
romaji: hotoke no kao mo sando.

romaji: kami wa souzousha desu. ten mo chi mo nin mo, kamiigai wa subetehizoubutsu desu.

romaji: kami wa souzousha desu. ten mo chi mo nin mo, kamiigai wa subetehizoubutsu desu.

romaji: kami wa souzousha desu. ten mo chi mo nin mo, kamiigai wa subetehizoubutsu desu.
meaning: God is the creator. Heaven and Earth and people and everything apart from God are created.

romaji: ( tokorode jinja o shitte imasuka ？) ( karukufureruteido niha. shinkoutaishou tonatta sonzai, iwayurutokorono shinkaku o matsurureihaishisetsu ne)
