japanese: 毎年、桜が見頃の頃に祭りが催される。
romaji: maitoshi, sakura ga migoro no goronimatsuri ga moyoosa reru.
meaning: Every year, a festival is held when it is the best time to see the cherry trees.

japanese: 九頭竜明神を祭るために灯篭をながす。
romaji: kuzuryuumyoujin o matsuru tameni tourou wonagasu.
meaning: Lanterns are floated to worship Great God Kuzuryū.

japanese: 小説だって絵と同様に練習が必要なんだから。
romaji: shousetsu datte e to douyou ni renshuu ga hitsuyou nandakara.
meaning: Because novels, just like paintings, need you to practice.

japanese: 倒れていた老人は、実は仏様だったのです。
romaji: taore teita roujin ha, jitsuhahotokesama dattanodesu.
meaning: The old man who'd fallen was really Buddha.

japanese: また一方で、若者たちは仏教に触れる中で、仏教を心の支えに必要なものと考え始めているようだ。
romaji: mata ippou de, wakamono tachiha bukkyou ni furerunaka de, bukkyou o kokoro no sasae ni hitsuyou namonoto kangaehajime teiruyouda.
meaning: On the other hand, there seem to be those among young folk who, while touching on Buddhism, have started to think of it as a vital spiritual support.

japanese: 奈良は大仏で有名です。
romaji: nara wa daibutsu de yuumei desu.
meaning: Nara is famous for Daibutsu.

japanese: これは神経質な。
romaji: kore wa shinkeishitsuna.
meaning: This is nervous(eness), (being) highly strung, sensitive(ness), neurotic.

japanese: 「聞いたよ、光一」「まあ皆までいうなって。分かってる。神社の夏祭りの一件でしょ？」
romaji: ( kii tayo, kouichi) ( maa mina madeiunatte. waka tteru. jinja no natsumatsuri no ikken desho ？)
meaning: "I've heard about it, Koichi." "You don't need to say anything more, I know. It's the summer festival incident at the shrine, right?"

japanese: 祭日が日曜にダブると月曜が休みになる。
romaji: saijitsu ga nichiyou ni dabu ruto getsuyou ga yasumi ninaru.
meaning: When a holiday falls on Sunday, we have an extra holiday on Monday.

japanese: これは絵画展。
romaji: kore wa kaigaten.
meaning: This is art exhibition, art show.

japanese: 油絵は少し離れて見るとよく見える。
romaji: aburae wa sukoshihanare te miru toyoku mie ru.
meaning: Oil paintings show to advantage at a distance.

japanese: 彼に忠告したところで、馬の耳に念仏だよ。
romaji: kare ni chuukoku shitatokorode, uma no mimi ni nenbutsu dayo.
meaning: Giving advice to him is like talking to a brick wall.

japanese: これは仏心。
romaji: kore wa hotokegokoro.
meaning: This is mercy, merciful heart, charity.

japanese: 初詣、ご利益があるのはどこの神社？
romaji: hatsumoude, go rieki gaarunohadokono jinja ？
meaning: New Year shrine visit; which shrines are potent?

japanese: 彼女は失神しそうに見えました。
romaji: kanojo wa shisshin shisouni mie mashita.
meaning: It seemed as if she was going to faint.

japanese: 僕は文化祭で女装した。
romaji: bokuhabunkasai de josou shita.
meaning: I dressed up as a girl for the school festival.

japanese: また雨が降っている。２月の雪まつりは無事行えるだろうか。
romaji: mata ame ga futsu teiru. 2 gatsu no yuki matsuriha bujiokonae rudarouka.
meaning: It's raining again. I wonder if we will be able to have the February snow festival?

japanese: 絵本は子供たちの頭を啓発する。
romaji: ehon wa kodomo tachino atama o keihatsu suru.
meaning: Picture books will cultivate the minds of children.

japanese: 絵具の赤と青を混ぜると紫になるって知ってた？
romaji: enogu no aka to ao o maze ruto murasaki ninarutte shitte ta ？
meaning: Did you know that if you mixed red and blue paint you obtained purple?

japanese: 黒塗りのリムジンがキーというタイヤの音と共に角を曲がった。
romaji: kuronuri no rimujin ga kii toiu taiya no oto to tomonikaku o magatsu ta.
meaning: A black limo rounded the corner with a squeal of tires.

japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
romaji: watashi hahizawo mage zuni ryouhou no teno hirawo toko ni tsukeru kotogadekiru.
meaning: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
romaji: watashi hahizawo mage zuni ryouhou no teno hirawo toko ni tsukeru kotogadekiru.
meaning: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

japanese: 彼女が角を曲がるとき私は彼女を見かけた。
romaji: kanojo ga kaku o magaru toki watashi wa kanojo o mikake ta.
meaning: I caught sight of her as she turned the corner.

japanese: これは曲げる。
romaji: kore wa mageru.
meaning: This is to bend, to cook, to bow, to curve, to curl, to lean, to tilt, to incline, to slant, to bend (the truth), to distort, to twist, to pervert, to yield (a point), to depart (from a principle), to ignore (what one really thinks), to pawn.

japanese: 彼は彼女に車を運転させるつもりはなかったのだが、彼女があまりにせがむものだから、彼の方がとうとう折れた。
romaji: karehakanojo ni kuruma o unten saserutsumorihanakattanodaga, kanojo gaamarinisegamumonodakara, kanohouga toutou ore ta.
meaning: He didn't intend to let her drive but she pestered him so much that he finally gave in.

japanese: 二つ折りにしたクッションを枕代わりに、僕はフローリングの上にカーペットを敷いただけの固い床へと横になる。
romaji: futatsuori nishita kusshon o makurakawari ni, bokuha furooringu no ueni kaapetto o shii tadakeno kataitoko heto yoko ninaru.
meaning: Using a doubled-up cushion in place of a pillow I lie down on the hard wooden floor with nothing but a carpet spread over it.

japanese: あ、そうだ。まゆに変なことしたら、背骨を折る。
romaji: a, souda. mayuni henna kotoshitara, sebone o oru.
meaning: One more thing. If you try anything on Mayu I'll break your spine.

japanese: 折れるより曲がれ。
romaji: ore ruyori magare.
meaning: Better to bend than break.

japanese: いずれにしても、この雪のふる宵に、ひとりの老婆が路ばたに坐っていたのは事実である。
romaji: izurenishitemo, kono yuki nofuru shou ni, hitorino rouba ga michi batani matsu teitanoha jijitsu dearu.
meaning: Anyhow, it's the truth that on this snowy night a lone old woman was sitting on the side of the road.

japanese: フロントローラーのスラスト角は２度、多分レース時にはもう少し角度を強める予定です。
romaji: furontorooraa no surasuto kaku wa 2 do, tabun reesu tokini hamou sukoshikakudo o tsuyome ru yotei desu.
meaning: The front-roller thrust angle is 2 degrees, probably there were plans to strengthen that angle a little when racing.

japanese: リストの「忘れられたワルツ第3番」は隠れた名曲だと思う。
romaji: risuto no ( wasure rareta warutsu dai 3 ban) wa kakure ta meikyoku dato omou.
meaning: I think that Liszt's "Forgotten Waltz No.3" is a hidden masterpiece.

japanese: 右折しなさい、そうすれば私の事務所が見つかります。
romaji: usetsu shinasai, sousureba watashi no jimusho ga mitsu karimasu.
meaning: Turn to the right, and you'll find my office.

japanese: 車は急に左折した。
romaji: kuruma wa kyuunisasetsu shita.
meaning: The car cut to the left.

japanese: 進路を開拓するという同じ目標を持った仲間同士が協力する。
romaji: shinro o kaitaku surutoiu onajimokuhyou o motsu ta nakamadoushi ga kyouryoku suru.
meaning: Companions with the same aim, to carve out their own future, cooperate with each other.

japanese: 夜になってきたので、私たちは家路に着いた。
romaji: yoru ninattekitanode, watashitachi wa ieji ni tsui ta.
meaning: Night coming on, we left for home.

japanese: 彼は次第に頭角をあらわしてきた。
romaji: karehashidai ni toukaku woarawashitekita.
meaning: He is gradually coming to the front.

japanese: 鉄道の線路を歩くのは危険だ。
romaji: tetsudou no senro o aruku noha kiken da.
meaning: It's dangerous to walk on railway lines.

japanese: この公園の西側に近いところは、道路の騒音も大きいが、奥にはいるともう聞こえない。
romaji: kono kouen no nishigawa ni chikai tokoroha, douro no souon mo ookii ga, oku nihairutomou kiko enai.
meaning: Near the west side of the park there's a lot of noise from the road, but when you go into the park you can't hear it any more.

japanese: もしスペンサーが文を足して訳し続けなければ、他の貢献者がきっと彼を追い抜くだろう。
romaji: moshi supensaa ga bun o tashi te yakushitsuzuke nakereba, hokanokoukenmono gakitto kare o oinuku darou.
meaning: If Spenser doesn't keep adding and translating sentences, the other contributors will surely surpass him.

japanese: 猟犬は鋭い嗅覚で獲物を追う。
romaji: ryouken wa surudoikyuukaku de emono o ou.
meaning: Hounds hunt by their keen scent.

japanese: 彼は古代史の分野で突っ込んだ研究をしている。
romaji: karehakodaishi no bunya de tsukkon da kenkyuu woshiteiru.
meaning: He's doing in-depth research on ancient history.

japanese: もうすぐ、トムの貯金が底を突く。
romaji: mousugu, tomu no chokin ga soko o tsuku.
meaning: Tom's savings will soon run out.

japanese: 「転がる石は苔をもつけず」はことわざである。
romaji: ( koroga ru ishi wa koke womotsukezu) hakotowazadearu.
meaning: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

japanese: 「転がる石は苔をもつけず」はことわざである。
romaji: ( koroga ru ishi wa koke womotsukezu) hakotowazadearu.
meaning: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

japanese: 彼は滑って、すんでのところで転ぶところだった。
romaji: karehasubetsu te, sundenotokorode korobu tokorodatta.
meaning: He slipped and nearly fell.

japanese: ある話によると、お金はあちらこちら転がることができるように丸かった。
romaji: aru hanashi niyoruto, o kin haachirakochira koroga rukotogadekiruyouni maruka tta.
meaning: According to one story, the money was round so that it could roll from place to place.

japanese: これは転がす。
romaji: kore wa korogasu.
meaning: This is to roll, to turn over, to tip over, to throw down, to leave, to buy and sell (quickly for a profit).

japanese: 彼は丘を転げるようにやってきた。
romaji: karehaoka o koroge ruyouniyattekita.
meaning: He came tumbling down the hill.

japanese: 二輪車が倒れずに走行するのには前輪が大きな役割を演じています。
romaji: nirinsha ga taore zuni soukou surunoniha zenrin ga ooki na yakuwari o enji teimasu.
meaning: The front wheel plays an important role in two-wheeled vehicles moving without falling over.

japanese: 木がどすんと音を立てて倒れるのが聞こえた。
romaji: ki gadosunto oto o tate te taore runoga kiko eta.
meaning: The tree was heard to crash to the ground.

japanese: 木こりは木を斧で切り倒す。
romaji: ki koriha ki o ono de kiritaosu.
meaning: The woodcutter fells a tree with an ax.

japanese: 彼女の車はバスに追突した。
romaji: kanojo no kuruma wa basu ni tsuitotsu shita.
meaning: Her car collided with a bus from behind.

japanese: 彼の声は悪霊の突然の咆哮にかき消される。
romaji: kanokoe wa akuryou no totsuzen no houkou nikaki kesa reru.
meaning: His voice was drowned out by the wraith's sudden howl.

japanese: 本末を転倒するな。
romaji: honmatsu o tentou suruna.
meaning: Don't put the cart before the horse.

japanese: 追及されて、つい、見え透いた嘘をついてしまった。
romaji: tsuikyuu sarete, tsui, miesui ta uso wotsuiteshimatta.
meaning: I was pressed by their questioning and slipped into telling an obvious lie.

japanese: 警棒で空をなぐりつけ、よろめいて体勢をたてなおしたガードマンは、自分に向かって突進してくる金網づくりのクズカゴを見た。
romaji: keibou de sora wonaguritsuke, yoromeite taisei wotatenaoshita gaadoman ha, jibun ni muka tte tosshinshi tekuru kanaami zukurino kuzukago o mita.
meaning: The guard's truncheon hit air. Off balance, he regained his posture to see a metal-mesh rubbish bin flying towards him.

japanese: この問題は、アイドルのエゴとヲタのエゴの衝突だ。
romaji: kono mondai ha, aidoru no ego to wota no ego no shoutotsu da.
meaning: This problem is the clash of the idol's and obsessive fan's egos.

japanese: 自転車は都会の環境を破壊することなく資源利用を持続することのできる道具である。
romaji: jitensha wa tokai no kankyou o hakai surukotonaku shigenriyou o jizoku surukotonodekiru dougu dearu.
meaning: Bicycles are tools for urban sustainability.

japanese: 無数の小企業が不景気のときに倒産した。
romaji: musuu no shoukigyou ga fukeiki notokini tousan shita.
meaning: Thousands of small businesses went under during the recession.

japanese: ５８１４を千の位に四捨五入すれば何になりますか。
romaji: 5 8 1 4 o sen no kurai ni shishagonyuu sureba nani ninarimasuka.
meaning: What is 5814 rounded to the nearest thousand?

japanese: ５８１４を千の位に四捨五入すれば何になりますか。
romaji: 5 8 1 4 o sen no kurai ni shishagonyuu sureba nani ninarimasuka.
meaning: What is 5814 rounded to the nearest thousand?

japanese: トランプを樫のテーブルに置いて。
romaji: toranpu o kashi no teeburu ni oi te.
meaning: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.

japanese: 机の上に寝かせて置くと転がって落ちることがあるので、試験管立てに立てておく。
romaji: tsukue no uenineka sete oku to koroga tte ochiru kotogaarunode, shikenkantate ni tate teoku.
meaning: If you leave them lying on the desk they may roll off, so stand them in the test-tube rack.

japanese: さらに、横から見ると、前歯は出っ歯の状態にあります。
romaji: sarani, yoko kara miru to, maeba wa deppa no joutai niarimasu.
meaning: Moreover, when viewed from the side, the front teeth are protruding.

japanese: インコやオウムと仲良く楽しく健やかに暮らすために、飼鳥の行動学やペットロスについて考える。
romaji: inko ya oumu to nakayokutanoshikusukoyaka ni kura sutameni, kaidori no koudougaku ya pettorosu nitsuite kangae ru.
meaning: In order to live happily and healthily with parakeets or parrots, you should understand the science of animal behavior for domesticated birds, and consider the emotional effect of eventually losing them.

japanese: 只見町は福島県南会津地方にあり、急峻な山を隔てて新潟との県境に位置しています。
romaji: tadamimachi wa fukushimakennanaizuchihou niari, kyuushun na yama o hedate te niigata tono kenzakai ni ichi shiteimasu.
meaning: Tadami is in Minamiaizu in Fukushima; cut off by steep mountains and located on the prefecture border with Niigata.

japanese: ＯＥＣＤの調査で北欧諸国が税率において世界の上位をキープした。
romaji: O E C D no chousa de hokuoushokoku ga zeiritsu nioite sekai no joui o kiipu shita.
meaning: In the OECD survey, northern European countries are keeping their high ranking in tax-rates.

japanese: 彼は時々傘を電車の中に置き忘れる。
romaji: karehatokidokikasa o densha no nakaniokiwasure ru.
meaning: Once in a while, he leaves his umbrella on the train.

japanese: ゴミ置き場はどこですか？
romaji: gomi okiba hadokodesuka ？
meaning: Where is the garbage area?

japanese: 農家の男の子が、小麦を乗せた小型トラックを過って横転させてしまった。
romaji: nouka no otokonoko ga, komugi o nose ta kogata torakku o ayamatsu te outen saseteshimatta.
meaning: A farm boy accidentally overturned his wagonload of wheat on the road.

japanese: その肖像画は美人の横顔を描いている。
romaji: sono shouzouga wa bijin no yokogao o egai teiru.
meaning: The portrait shows the profile of a beautiful woman.

japanese: これは横書き。
romaji: kore wa yokogaki.
meaning: This is writing horizontally.

japanese: 中央には机が据えられていて、赤い革張りの回転椅子がそえてあった。
romaji: chuuou niha tsukue ga sue rareteite, akaikawahari no kaiten'isu gasoeteatta.
meaning: A desk stood in the centre, with a red leather swivel chair.

japanese: 十中八九、彼は一位になるだろう。
romaji: jutchuuhakku, karehaichii ninarudarou.
meaning: In nine cases out of ten he will take the first place.

japanese: 明らかに、彼らは彼の富と地位を妬んでいる。
romaji: akiraka ni, karera wa kanotomi to chii o to ndeiru.
meaning: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.

japanese: 「順路→」といったかんじの看板を設置したいと思うんですけど、これを英語で作るとどうなるでしょうか？
romaji: ( junro →) toittakanjino kanban o setchi shitaito omou ndesukedo, korewo eigo de tsukuru todounarudeshouka ？
meaning: I'd like to set up a sign like, "This Way ->," but what would it be if I made it in English?

japanese: 老婦人は、道路を横断するのを手伝ったことに対して、私に感謝した。
romaji: roufujin ha, douro o oudan surunowo tetsudatsu takotoni taishi te, watashi ni kanshashi ta.
meaning: The old lady thanked me for helping her across the road.

japanese: これは横道。
romaji: kore wa yokomichi.
meaning: This is byway, sidestreet, cross street, wrong way, digression.

japanese: また後でかけ直していただけませんか？
romaji: mata atode kake naoshi teitadakemasenka ？
meaning: Could you call again later, please?

japanese: また後でかけ直していただけませんか？
romaji: mata atode kake naoshi teitadakemasenka ？
meaning: Could you call again later, please?

japanese: また後でかけ直していただけませんか？
romaji: mata atode kake naoshi teitadakemasenka ？
meaning: Could you call again later, please?

japanese: これは直な。
romaji: kore wa naona.
meaning: This is straight, ordinary, common, doing nothing.

japanese: これは直す auch 治す。
romaji: kore wa naosu.
meaning: This is to cure, to heal, to fix, to correct, to repair, to do over again (after -masu bas of verb), to replace, to put back as it was, to convert (into a different state), to transform.

japanese: 薬を飲み始めると、すぐに痛みなどの症状はとれてきますが、すぐに潰瘍がなおるわけではありません。
romaji: kusuri o nomihajime ruto, suguni itami nadono shoujou hatoretekimasuga, suguni kaiyou ganaoruwakedehaarimasen.
meaning: When you start taking medicine it begins working on symptoms, like pain, right away, but that doesn't mean that the ulcer heals right away.

japanese: 彼は直ちにこの部屋を出て行けと命じた。
romaji: karehatadachi nikono heya o deteike to meiji ta.
meaning: He ordered me to leave the room at once.

japanese: 必要のない語はどれでも線を引いて消さねばならない。
romaji: hitsuyou nonai go hadoredemo sen o hii te kesa nebanaranai.
meaning: You should cross out any word you don't need.

japanese: しかし、逆もまた真である。
romaji: shikashi, gyaku momata makoto dearu.
meaning: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.

japanese: 彼は世の風潮に逆らう。
romaji: karehayonofuuchou ni sakara u.
meaning: He is swimming against the tide.

japanese: 君が側にいてくれれば何もいらない。
romaji: kun ga gawa niitekurereba nanimo iranai.
meaning: You're by my side; everything's fine now.

japanese: 直進してください。
romaji: chokushin shitekudasai.
meaning: Go straight ahead.

japanese: 正直なところ、その当時の僕は血縁がどうとか、続柄がどうとか、そういう話はまるで理解出来ちゃいなかった。
romaji: shoujiki natokoro, sono touji no bokuhaketsuen gadoutoka, zokugara gadoutoka, souiu hanashi hamarude rikaidekichi yainakatta.
meaning: Truthfully, at that time, I didn't have the first idea about such talk: family links, blood relations or whatever.

japanese: これは直接な。
romaji: kore wa chokusetsuna.
meaning: This is direct, immediate, personal, firsthand.

japanese: 先回は逆子でした。
romaji: senkai wa sakago deshita.
meaning: Last time I had a breech delivery.

japanese: 彼は壁の上に直線を書いた。
romaji: karehakabe no uenichokusen o kai ta.
meaning: He drew a straight line on the wall.

japanese: 率直なご意見をお聞かせください。
romaji: sotchoku nago iken woo kika sekudasai.
meaning: Stop beating around the bush and tell us what you really think.

japanese: 形勢は逆転した。
romaji: keisei wa gyakuten shita.
meaning: Now the shoe is on the other foot.

japanese: 彼は怒りで逆上していた。
romaji: karehaikari de gyakujoushi teita.
meaning: He was beside himself with rage.

japanese: 想像力は私たちの生活のどの側面にも影響を与える。
romaji: souzouryoku wa watashitachi no seikatsu nodono sokumen nimo eikyou o atae ru.
meaning: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.

japanese: 注・かなり昔に描いてるのでクオリティは低いです。
romaji: chuu ・ kanari mukashi ni egai terunode kuoritei wa hikui desu.
meaning: NB: This was drawn a long time ago so the quality is low.

japanese: 彼はいつも仕事に全力を注ぐ。
romaji: kareha itsumo shigoto ni zenryoku o sosogu.
meaning: He always works with all his might.

japanese: ただ、毎日だとさすがに飽きるだろう。もっと料理のバリエーションを増やさないと。
romaji: tada, mainichi datosasugani aki rudarou. motto ryouri no barieeshon o fuyasa naito.
meaning: It's just if we have it every day we're bound to get fed up with it. I must increase the variety of my cooking.

japanese: 接尾辞について、１：【-ion】「行動、状態、過程、結果」などの意を表す名詞を作る。
romaji: setsubiji nitsuite, 1: ( -ion) ( koudou, joutai, katei, kekka) nadono i o arawasumeishi o tsukuru.
meaning: Suffixes, 1: "-ion" creates nouns that show the meaning of 'action, state, process, results,' and so on.

japanese: ぼくはやばい橋は渡りたくない。
romaji: bokuhayabai hashi wa watari takunai.
meaning: I don't want to do anything risky.

japanese: 調べを進めるうちに、頭蓋骨が、何か重い一撃を受けて打ち砕かれているのが明らかになった。
romaji: shirabe o susume ruuchini, zugaikotsu ga, nanikaomoiichigeki o uke te uchikudaka reteirunoga akiraka ninatta.
meaning: Closer examination revealed that the skull had been crushed by some heavy blow.

japanese: 調べを進めるうちに、頭蓋骨が、何か重い一撃を受けて打ち砕かれているのが明らかになった。
romaji: shirabe o susume ruuchini, zugaikotsu ga, nanikaomoiichigeki o uke te uchikudaka reteirunoga akiraka ninatta.
meaning: Closer examination revealed that the skull had been crushed by some heavy blow.

japanese: 私はもっと敵の抵抗があると踏んでたんだけど、むしろ中枢に進むほど敵が減ってきてる・・・。おかしいと思わないかしら？
romaji: watashi hamotto teki no teikou gaaruto fun detandakedo, mushiro chuusuu ni susumu hodo teki ga hetsu tekiteru ・・・. okashiito omowa naikashira ？
meaning: I had expected stronger resistance from the enemy but if anything there are less of them as we advance to the centre... Don't you think that's strange?

japanese: 例えば、たばこをぷかぷか吸う先生が、たばこを吸う生徒に注意してもその注意は矛盾しているだろう。
romaji: tatoeba, tabakowopukapuka suusensei ga, tabakowo suuseito ni chuui shitemosono chuui wa mujun shiteirudarou.
meaning: For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.

japanese: 来月やってくる彼の最近の映画に注目しなさい。
romaji: raigetsu yattekuru kanosaikin no eiga ni chuumoku shinasai.
meaning: Watch out for his latest movie which comes out next month.

japanese: 歌詞を見てみれば、あまり意味が無いことに気付くでしょう。
romaji: kashi o mite mireba, amari imi ga nai kotoni kizuku deshou.
meaning: If you look at the lyrics, they don't really mean much.

japanese: 石橋をたたいて渡れ。
romaji: ishibashi wotataite watare.
meaning: Look before you leap.

japanese: 「ご注文は？」「オレンジジュース」「アイス付きで？」「そう」「まいど」
romaji: ( go chuumon wa ？) ( orenjijuusu) ( aisu tsuki de ？) ( sou) ( maido)
meaning: "Your order?" "Orange juice." "With ice?" "Yes." "Thanks for your business."

japanese: 車の速度を落とす装置（ハンプや狭さく）について、意見があったら書いてください。
romaji: kuruma no sokudo o oto su souchi ( hanpu ya semasa ku) nitsuite, iken gaattara kai tekudasai.
meaning: If you have any opinions concerning traffic calming devices (humps, curb extensions, etc.) please write them.

japanese: 見つけたのは僕です。意識を喪っていたので、保健室に運びました。
romaji: mitsu ketanoha boku desu. ishiki o mo tteitanode, hokenshitsu ni hakobi mashita.
meaning: It was I who found her. She'd lost consciousness, so I carried her to the infirmary.

japanese: 鉄橋まで川沿いに歩いて行った。
romaji: tekkyou made kawazoi ni arui te itta.
meaning: I walked along the river until I got to the iron bridge.

japanese: 旅客は歩道橋を使って路線を渡ってください。
romaji: ryokyaku wa hodoukyou o tsukatterosen o watatsu tekudasai.
meaning: Passengers must take the footbridge to cross the railroad tracks.

japanese: 私達は決勝戦に進出した。
romaji: watashitachi wa kesshousen ni shinshutsu shita.
meaning: We advanced to the finals.

japanese: 彼女は彼に仕えた。
romaji: kanojo wa kare ni tsukae ta.
meaning: She attended on him.

japanese: 地獄で支配するのは、天で仕えるのに勝る。
romaji: jigoku de shihai surunoha, ten de tsukae runoni masaru.
meaning: Better to reign in Hell, than serve in Heaven.

japanese: ダニエルさんが良い職を得た。
romaji: danieru sanga yoishoku o eta.
meaning: Daniel got a good job.

japanese: 学校に全てを求めることはできない。
romaji: gakkou ni subete o motome rukotohadekinai.
meaning: One can't expect everything from schools.

japanese: 学校に全てを求めることはできない。
romaji: gakkou ni subete o motome rukotohadekinai.
meaning: One can't expect everything from schools.

japanese: 「これが探していたものだ」と彼は叫んだ。
romaji: ( korega sagashi teitamonoda) to karehasaken da.
meaning: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.

japanese: いい監督を探すのに3年費やしたが、見つからなかった。
romaji: ii kantoku o sagasu noni 3 nentsuiyashi taga, mitsu karanakatta.
meaning: I spent three years looking for a good director, but couldn't find one.

japanese: 我々の至上命題はこの紛争にすっぱりと終止符を打つことであって、そのために妥協点を探ることも辞さない。
romaji: wareware no shijoumeidai hakono funsou nisupparito shuushifu o utsu kotodeatte, sonotameni dakyouten o saguru kotomo jisa nai.
meaning: Our top priority is to settle this dispute once and for all, so we are ready to meet them halfway.

japanese: ワインにはいろいろなタイプがあり、それによって育成の仕方もさまざまです。
romaji: wain nihairoirona taipu gaari, soreniyotte ikusei no shikata mosamazamadesu.
meaning: There are various types of wines and the way they are matured varies accordingly.

japanese: 私は自分の仕事を気に入っています。
romaji: watashi wa jibun no shigoto o kiniitsu teimasu.
meaning: I like my job very much.

japanese: 彼らは給仕が急いでくるのを見た。
romaji: karera wa kyuuji ga isoi dekurunowo mita.
meaning: They saw the waiter coming in a hurry.

japanese: 面接はうまく運んだので彼は就職できた。
romaji: mensetsu haumaku hakon danode karehashuushoku dekita.
meaning: The interview went off so well that he got the job.

japanese: その会社では高い専門性が要求される。
romaji: sono kaisha deha takaisenmonsei ga youkyuu sareru.
meaning: A high degree of specialization is required in that company.

japanese: これらの図式は求職に関する様々なアプローチを示している。
romaji: korerano zushiki wa kyuushoku ni kansu ru samazamana apuroochi o shimeshi teiru.
meaning: These diagrams demonstrate different possible approaches to job seeking.

japanese: 両親は僕の月々５万円の仕送りをあてにしている。
romaji: ryoushin wa boku no tsukizuki 5 man'en no shiokuri woatenishiteiru.
meaning: My parents rely on my monthly allowance of fifty thousand yen.

japanese: 自分の才能を思う存分生かすには、自分にもっとふさわしい職業、新しい職場を見つけることです。
romaji: jibun no sainou o omouzonbunika suniha, jibun nimottofusawashii shokugyou, atarashiishokuba o mitsu kerukotodesu.
meaning: In order to bring out your talents to the full you need to a profession more suited to you, to find a new work place.

japanese: 父と話し合って、転職を決意した。
romaji: chichi to hanashiatsu te, tenshoku o ketsui shita.
meaning: I discussed it with my father and decided to change my job.

japanese: トムはフランス語教師の求人に応募した。
romaji: tomu wa furansu gokyoushi no kyuujin ni oubo shita.
meaning: Tom applied for a job as a French teacher.

japanese: 女性に彼氏がいるかいないかの探りを入れるベストな方法が有れば教えてください。
romaji: josei ni kareshi gairukainaikano saguri o ire ru besuto na houhou ga are ba oshie tekudasai.
meaning: If there's a good way to sound out whether a woman has a boyfriend or not please tell me.

japanese: 俺は慌てて探し物に本腰を入れ始めた。
romaji: ore wa awate te sagashimono ni hongoshi o irehajime ta.
meaning: I hurriedly started searching in earnest.

japanese: この仕事の面白みは、常に技術が進化しているので、刺激を受け続けられることですね。
romaji: kono shigoto no omoshiromi ha, tsunenigijutsu ga shinka shiteirunode, shigeki o uketsuzuke rarerukotodesune.
meaning: The fun thing about this job is that the technology is continually advancing so it continues to be stimulating.

japanese: この仕事の面白みは、常に技術が進化しているので、刺激を受け続けられることですね。
romaji: kono shigoto no omoshiromi ha, tsunenigijutsu ga shinka shiteirunode, shigeki o uketsuzuke rarerukotodesune.
meaning: The fun thing about this job is that the technology is continually advancing so it continues to be stimulating.

japanese: この仕事の面白みは、常に技術が進化しているので、刺激を受け続けられることですね。
romaji: kono shigoto no omoshiromi ha, tsunenigijutsu ga shinka shiteirunode, shigeki o uketsuzuke rarerukotodesune.
meaning: The fun thing about this job is that the technology is continually advancing so it continues to be stimulating.

japanese: 私は巴里滞在中、二三の画家諸君と識り合ひになり、ちよいちよいアトリエを訪ねるやうなこともあつたが、いつでもその仕事振り、生活振りに多大の興味を惹かれた。
romaji: watashi wa paritaizaichuu, nisan no gakashokun to shiki ri ahi ninari, chiyoichiyoi atorie o tazune ruyaunakotomoatsutaga, itsudemosono shigotofuri, seikatsufuri ni tadai no kyoumi o hika reta.
meaning: When I was in Paris, I became acquainted with two or three painters, and I went to visit their atelier from time to time. I was always fascinated by their method of work and their way of life.

japanese: 鍵となる問題は何を得ることができるかではなく、何を失わなければならないかである。
romaji: kagi tonaru mondai wa naniwoeru kotogadekirukadehanaku, naniwoushinawa nakerebanaranaikadearu.
meaning: The key question is not what can I gain but what do I have to lose.

japanese: 友を永遠に失うくらいならばその友達のことを我慢しなさい。
romaji: tomo o eien ni ushinau kurainarabasono tomodachi nokotowo gaman shinasai.
meaning: Have patience with a friend rather than lose him forever.

japanese: お世話になった全ての方々にお礼の言葉を述べたいと思います。
romaji: o sewa ninatta subete no katagata nio rei no kotoba o nobe taito omoi masu.
meaning: I'd like to say a word of thanks to all those gentlemen and ladies whose care I have been in.

japanese: お世話になった全ての方々にお礼の言葉を述べたいと思います。
romaji: o sewa ninatta subete no katagata nio rei no kotoba o nobe taito omoi masu.
meaning: I'd like to say a word of thanks to all those gentlemen and ladies whose care I have been in.

japanese: これは常夏。
romaji: kore wa tokonatsu.
meaning: This is everlasting summer.

japanese: 現在、通常のサービスの早急な復旧に努めています。
romaji: genzai, tsuujou no saabisu no sakkyuu na fukkyuu ni tsutome teimasu.
meaning: We are currently working to restore normal service as soon as possible.

japanese: アジア諸国などから出稼ぎにきた外国人をメイドとして使うのが常識のようになっている。
romaji: ajia shokoku nadokara dekasegi nikita gaikokujin o meido toshite tsukau noga joushiki noyouninatteiru.
meaning: It has become common practise to employ foreigners working abroad from Asian countries as maids.

japanese: 彼女なら面識があります。
romaji: kanojo nara menshiki gaarimasu.
meaning: I have an acquaintance with her.

japanese: 父が失業して一年になる。
romaji: chichi ga shitsugyou shite ichinen ninaru.
meaning: My father has been out of work for a year.

japanese: 君らしくないかも知れないが、せめて礼儀くらい守ったらどうだ。
romaji: kun rashikunaikamo shire naiga, semete reigi kurai mamotsu taradouda.
meaning: You could at least try to be a bit more polite, even though it's not like you.

japanese: 失礼に振舞ったりしないのが一番だと思う。
romaji: shitsurei ni furumatsu tarishinainoga ichiban dato omou.
meaning: I think it is best not to be impolite.

japanese: 多くの人が日常のことについて文を書く。
romaji: ooku no nin ga nichijou nokotonitsuite bun o kaku.
meaning: Most people write about their daily life.

japanese: 唯一の有益な知識とは、よいものを捜し求め、悪いものを避ける方法をわれわれに教える知識である。
romaji: yuiitsu no yuueki na chishiki toha, yoimonowo sagashimotome, warui monowo sake ru houhou wowarewareni oshie ru chishiki dearu.
meaning: The only useful knowledge is that which teaches us how to seek what is good and avoid what is evil.

japanese: 郵便局で物を送ったら郵便局のミスでその品を紛失された。
romaji: yuubinkyoku de mono o okutsu tara yuubinkyoku no misu desono hin o funshitsu sareta.
meaning: When the thing was sent into the post office, the goods were lost due to the mistake of the post office.

japanese: これは礼金。
romaji: kore wa reikin.
meaning: This is finder's fee, reward, honorarium, key money.

japanese: 誰かが無理してまであなたを手伝ってくれた時にはお礼状を書きなさい。
romaji: dareka ga muri shitemadeanatawo tetsudatsu tekureta tokini hao reijou o kaki nasai.
meaning: Write a thank-you note when someone goes out of his or her way to help you.

japanese: 労なくして益なし。
romaji: rou nakushite masu nashi.
meaning: No pain, no gain.

japanese: 丸一日オンラインで君を見ないなんてびっくりだよ。
romaji: maruichinichi onrain de kun o mina inantebikkuridayo.
meaning: It almost scared me not to see you online for a whole day.

japanese: バカンスに行くのが待ち遠しい。
romaji: bakansu ni iku noga machidooshii.
meaning: I can't wait to go on a vacation.

japanese: 嵐の後すぐ、そのラジオ局は放送を再開した。
romaji: arashi no nochi sugu, sono rajio kyoku wa housou o saikai shita.
meaning: The radio station came back on the air shortly after the storm.

japanese: 夜眠れなくて彼は疲労して顔色が悪かった。
romaji: yorunemure nakute karehahirou shite kaoiro ga waruka tta.
meaning: He was pale with fatigue after his sleepless night.

japanese: 社長が社員の主体的な取り組みを促した。
romaji: shachou ga shain no shutaiteki na torikumi o unagashi ta.
meaning: The president urged employees to act on their initiative.

japanese: 彼女はスーパーマーケットの店員である。
romaji: kanojo wa suupaamaaketto no ten'in dearu.
meaning: She is a clerk in the supermarket.

japanese: 物を視覚的に覚える器官は視床下部の下にある。
romaji: mono o shikakuteki ni oboe ru kikan wa shishoukabu no shitani aru.
meaning: The sight memory organ is below the hypothalamus.

japanese: 有名なその外交官は快く委員会に参加してくれた。
romaji: yuumei nasono gaikoukan wa kokoroyokuiinkai ni sanka shitekureta.
meaning: The noted diplomat readily participated in the committee.

japanese: これは官民。
romaji: kore wa kanmin.
meaning: This is government and people.

japanese: 郵便局まで乗せてくださいませんか。
romaji: yuubinkyoku made nose tekudasaimasenka.
meaning: Would you mind giving me a ride to the post office?

japanese: 利用されている薬局の名前を教えてください。
romaji: riyou sareteiru yakkyoku no namae o oshie tekudasai.
meaning: What's the name of your pharmacy?

japanese: 勇敢に難局に立ち向かい、その結果は神の審判にまつほかは、包囲から逃れる方法はない。
romaji: yuukan ni nankyoku ni tachimukai, sono kekka wa kami no shinpan nimatsuhokaha, houi kara nogare ru houhou hanai.
meaning: There is no way out of the siege except to take the bull by the horns and let God judge the outcome.

japanese: 諸君らのたゆまぬ努力と労働によって、ついに我らがアジトが完成した！！
romaji: shokun ranotayumanu doryoku to roudou niyotte, tsuini warera ga ajito ga kanseishi ta!!
meaning: Ladies and Gentlemen, thanks to your untiring efforts our hideout is finally complete!!

japanese: 本校の生徒の全員が大学に進学するわけではない。
romaji: honkou no seito no zen'in ga daigaku ni shingaku suruwakedehanai.
meaning: Not all the students of this school go on to university.

japanese: 列車は満員だった。そこで彼女は２等車で旅行せねばならなかったし、ずっと立っていなければならなかった。
romaji: ressha wa man'in datta. sokode kanojo wa 2 nadokuruma de ryokou senebanaranakattashi, zutto tatsu teinakerebanaranakatta.
meaning: The train was full, so she was obliged to travel second-class, and had to stand all the way.

japanese: これは官邸。
romaji: kore wa kantei.
meaning: This is official residence (e.g. of prime minister).

japanese: 彼の辞職で官僚の席に空きができた。
romaji: kanojishoku de kanryou no seki ni aki gadekita.
meaning: His resignation left a vacancy in the cabinet.

japanese: 結局、法案は提出断念に追い込まれたのだった。
romaji: kekkyoku, houan wa teishutsudannen ni oikoma retanodatta.
meaning: In the end the bill was forced into being withdrawn.

japanese: これは局地。
romaji: kore wa kyokuchi.
meaning: This is municipal, limited area, locality.

japanese: せっかく採用した派遣社員がすぐに辞めてしまった。
romaji: sekkaku saiyou shita hakenshain gasuguni yame teshimatta.
meaning: The temporary workers that we managed to employ left work right away.

japanese: 彼女は仕事を辞めることにした。
romaji: kanojo wa shigoto o yame rukotonishita.
meaning: She decided to resign her job.

japanese: 立ち退きの予告を受けた。
romaji: tachishirizoki no yokoku o uke ta.
meaning: We received an eviction notice.

japanese: おい、いい加減パンツネタはやめとけよな、読者が退く、ドンビキ。
romaji: oi, ii kagen pantsuneta hayametokeyona, dokusha ga shirizoku, donbiki.
meaning: Hey, it's about time you quit it with the panty jokes. You'll put off the readers, you creeper!

japanese: これは退ける。
romaji: kore wa shirizokeru.
meaning: This is to repel, to drive away, to repulse, to reject.

japanese: それで雪を踏み固めてブロックを作り、それを積むような方法が適しているんですね。
romaji: sorede yuki o fumikatame te burokku o tsukuri, sorewo tsumu youna houhou ga tekishi teirundesune.
meaning: And so the method that works is treading down the snow to harden it, making blocks and piling them up.

japanese: 雪がしんしんと降り積もる・・・オレの体に。
romaji: yuki gashinshinto oritsumo ru ・・・ore no karada ni.
meaning: Snow falls silently and piles up ... on top of me.

japanese: それで雪を踏み固めてブロックを作り、それを積むような方法が適しているんですね。
romaji: sorede yuki o fumikatame te burokku o tsukuri, sorewo tsumu youna houhou ga tekishi teirundesune.
meaning: And so the method that works is treading down the snow to harden it, making blocks and piling them up.

japanese: このような辞書には、「冷蔵庫」という言葉を使った例文が少なくとも2つは載っているはずだ。
romaji: konoyouna jisho niha, ( reizouko) toiu kotoba o tsukattareibun ga sukunakutomo 2 tsuha notsu teiruhazuda.
meaning: In a dictionary like this one there should be at least two sentences with "fridge".

japanese: 本気で似合うと思っていたらしいシャツは辞退し、淡いブルーのポロシャツをいただくことにした。
romaji: honki de niau to omotte itarashii shatsu wa jitai shi, awai buruu no poroshatsu woitadakukotonishita.
meaning: The shirt she apparently seriously thought suited me I turned down and decided to accept a light blue polo shirt.

japanese: ねぇ遊んでよ、とっても退屈なの！
romaji: nee asonde yo, tottemo taikutsu nano!
meaning: Come on, play with me, I'm so bored!

japanese: 少年は十二才で音楽学校を退学させられた。
romaji: shounen wa juunisai de ongakugakukou o taigaku saserareta.
meaning: The boy was expelled from music school when he was 12.

japanese: 彼らの費用の見積もりは大幅な計算違いだった。
romaji: karera no hiyou no mitsumori wa oohaba na keisanchigai datta.
meaning: Their estimate of the cost was wide of the mark.

japanese: 畑は面積が３００エーカー以上ある。
romaji: hatake wa menseki ga 3 0 0 eekaa ijou aru.
meaning: The field measures more than 300 acres.

japanese: 私はいつも辞典を３冊手元に置いています。
romaji: watashi haitsumo jiten o 3 satsutemoto ni oi teimasu.
meaning: I always keep three dictionaries at hand.

japanese: 私は内閣の総辞職があると思う。
romaji: watashi wa naikaku no soujishoku gaaruto omou.
meaning: My guess is that there will be a resignation of the cabinet.

japanese: 彼らは戦術を急に変更して軍を後退させた。
romaji: karera wa senjutsu o kyuunihenkou shite gun o koutai saseta.
meaning: They moved the troops back in a sudden change of tactics.

japanese: 同じ頃、事務員・有村夏恵は、今月を限りに退職する旨を五鬼上に申し入れた。
romaji: onajigoro, jimuin ・ arimuranatsue ha, kongetsu o kagiri ni taishoku suru mune o gokijou ni moushiire ta.
meaning: At the same time, the clerk Natsue Arimura told Gokijo of her intent to resign after this month.

japanese: 彼女は古新聞紙を山積みにして置いておいた。
romaji: kanojo wa furushinbunkami o yamazumi nishite oi teoita.
meaning: She left the old newspapers lying in a heap.

japanese: スコットくん、今すぐ宣伝予算を立て給え！
romaji: sukotto kun, imasu gu sendenyosan o tatetamae!
meaning: Scott, prepare the advertising budget right now!

japanese: 凝った彫刻のしてある鞘に収まった長剣。
romaji: kotsu ta choukoku noshitearu saya ni osama tta chouken.
meaning: A longsword sheathed in an intricately engraved scabbard.

japanese: 最後にはうまく収まるだろう。
romaji: saigo nihaumaku osama rudarou.
meaning: It'll come right in the end.

japanese: 彼が選挙で勝利を収めるのは明らかだ。
romaji: kare ga senkyo de shouri o osame runoha akiraka da.
meaning: It is apparent that he will win the election.

japanese: なんとかそこで支えよ。入市を許すな。
romaji: nantokasokode sasae yo. nyuushi o yurusu na.
meaning: Hold them there! Don't let them into the city!

japanese: 氷は私たちを支えるほど厚くない。
romaji: koori wa watashitachi o sasae ruhodo atsuku nai.
meaning: The ice is not thick enough to hold our weight.

japanese: 矢が厚い板を貫通した。
romaji: ya ga atsuiita o kantsuu shita.
meaning: The arrow pierced the thick board.

japanese: 片方の本は薄く、他方は厚い。
romaji: katahou no hon wa usuku, tahou wa atsui.
meaning: One book is thin, and the other is thick.

japanese: 今日は給料日である。
romaji: konnichihakyuuryoubi dearu.
meaning: It is a payday today.

japanese: 時給はいくら？
romaji: jikyuu haikura ？
meaning: How much is your hourly pay?

japanese: 日本は収支を合わせるためには貿易に頼らなければならない。
romaji: nippon wa shuushi o awa serutameniha boueki ni tayora nakerebanaranai.
meaning: Japan must depend on foreign trade to make ends meet.

japanese: 彼女は支配人の助手として働いている。
romaji: kanojo wa shihainin no joshu toshite hatarai teiru.
meaning: She works as an assistant to the manager.

meaning: This is foreign ministerial conference, meeting of foreign ministers.

japanese: 彼は不成功に終わった商談について意見を述べた。
romaji: karehafuseikou ni owa tta shoudan nitsuite iken o nobe ta.
meaning: He commented on his unsuccessful business negotiation.

japanese: 薬は医者の指示によってのみしようされるべきです。
romaji: kusuri wa isha no shiji niyottenomishiyousarerubekidesu.
meaning: Drugs should be used only at the direction of a doctor.

japanese: 「ハムレット」はこれまでで最もおもしろい戯曲だと言われている。
romaji: ( hamuretto) hakoremadede mottomo omoshiroi gikyoku dato iwa reteiru.
meaning: It is said that "Hamlet" is the most interesting play ever written.

japanese: 「ハムレット」はこれまでで最もおもしろい戯曲だと言われている。
romaji: ( hamuretto) hakoremadede mottomo omoshiroi gikyoku dato iwa reteiru.
meaning: It is said that "Hamlet" is the most interesting play ever written.

japanese: 彼女はゴルフクラブに入会を申し込んだ。
romaji: kanojo wa gorufukurabu ni nyuukai o moushikon da.
meaning: She applied for the membership in a golf club.

japanese: テレビを点け、彼女がブラウン管の前で遊弋している。「おい、飯だぞ？」
romaji: terebi o tsuke, kanojo ga buraun kan no mae de yuuyoku shiteiru. ( oi, meshi dazo ？)
meaning: Television turned on, she patrols in front of the CRT. "Hey you, food's up!"

japanese: 私たちは兄弟として共に生きることを知らなければならない。さもなくば、愚か者として共に滅びるであろう。
romaji: watashitachi wa kyoudai toshite tomoniiki rukotowo shira nakerebanaranai. samonakuba, orokamono toshite tomonihorobi rudearou.
meaning: We must learn to live together as brothers, or we will perish together as fools.

japanese: 日本は１９９１年、世界最大の政府援助供与国だった。
romaji: nippon wa 1 9 9 1 nen, sekaisaidai no seifuenjokyouyokuni datta.
meaning: Japan was the world's largest donor of ODA in 1991.

japanese: 偉大な天才は最短の伝記を有する。
romaji: idai na tensai wa saitan no denki o yuusu ru.
meaning: Great geniuses have the shortest biographies.

japanese: これは副賞。
romaji: kore wa fukushou.
meaning: This is extra prize.

japanese: 副社長によると、会社はいまだに外国の会社から契約をもらっていない。
romaji: fukushachou niyoruto, kaisha haimadani gaikoku no kaisha kara keiyaku womoratteinai.
meaning: According to the vice president, the company has yet to receive a contract from a foreign company.

japanese: 水道管が破裂した。
romaji: suidoukan ga haretsu shita.
meaning: The water pipe burst.

japanese: 彼は管理職に昇進した。
romaji: karehakanrishoku ni shoushin shita.
meaning: He was advanced to a managerial post.

japanese: 彼を通して私は町の有力者と知り合いになった。
romaji: kare o toushi te watashi wa machi no yuuryokusha to shiriai ninatta.
meaning: Through him I got acquainted with the big names of the town.

japanese: 陽気な席で、人気者の隣に、興ざめの者が座っていることがよくある。
romaji: youki na seki de, ninkimono no tonari ni, kyouza meno mono ga suwatsu teirukotogayokuaru.
meaning: At a hilarious party, one frequently finds a wet blanket sitting next to the life of the party.

japanese: 彼女は記者に突きつけられた唐突な質問に当惑した様子だった。
romaji: kanojo wa kisha ni tsuki tsukerareta toutotsu na shitsumon ni touwaku shita yousu datta.
meaning: She looked puzzled at the abrupt question posed by a reporter.

japanese: 僕が最後に自分の考えを伝えた人は、僕を気違いだと思ったようだ。
romaji: boku ga saigo ni jibun no kangae o tsutae ta nin ha, boku o kichigai dato omotta youda.
meaning: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.

japanese: それは最近の写真？
romaji: soreha saikin no shashin ？
meaning: Is it a recent picture?

japanese: あの日が私の人生で最高の日だった。
romaji: ano nichi ga watashi no jinsei de saikou no nichi datta.
meaning: That was the best day of my life.

japanese: 副作用としては、視力障害があります。
romaji: fukusayou toshiteha, shiryokushougai gaarimasu.
meaning: This has visual impairment as a side effect.

japanese: 領収書は必ず保管してください。
romaji: ryoushuusho wa kanarazuhokan shitekudasai.
meaning: Make sure you save the receipt.

japanese: また一方で、若者たちは仏教に触れる中で、仏教を心の支えに必要なものと考え始めているようだ。
romaji: mata ippou de, wakamono tachiha bukkyou ni furerunaka de, bukkyou o kokoro no sasae ni hitsuyou namonoto kangaehajime teiruyouda.
meaning: On the other hand, there seem to be those among young folk who, while touching on Buddhism, have started to think of it as a vital spiritual support.

japanese: 良い医者は患者に説明する時、人体模型を使うなどして、わかりやすく説明してくれる。
romaji: yoiisha wa kanja ni setsumeisu ru toki, jintaimokei o tsukau nadoshite, wakariyasuku setsumeishi tekureru.
meaning: Good doctors explain things to patients in easily understandable ways, using anatomical models and such.

japanese: かつてはロードローラーは馬が曳いていたが、蒸気機関の発明により、スチームローラーが現れた。
romaji: katsuteha roodorooraa wa uma ga ei iteitaga, joukikikan no hatsumei niyori, suchiimurooraa ga araware ta.
meaning: Horses used to pull road-rollers, but the steamroller arrived with the invention of the steam engine.

japanese: これは現す auch 表す。
romaji: kore wa arawasu.
meaning: This is to represent, to signify, to stand for, to reveal, to show, to display, to express, to make widely known.

japanese: これは現れる or 表れる。
romaji: kore wa arawareru.
meaning: This is to appear, to come in sight, to become visible, to come out, to embody, to materialize, to be expressed (e.g. in emotions), to become apparent (e.g. trends, effects).

japanese: ロバート・ハンセンが、旧ソ連に秘密情報を売りさばいた容疑で逮捕された。
romaji: robaato・hansen ga, kyuu so tsuranihimitsujouhou o uri sabaita yougi de taiho sareta.
meaning: Robert Hansen was arrested on suspicion of having sold off secret information to the former Soviet Union.

japanese: 昔の作品ですが、ネーム無しで好き放題やってしまったので無駄に長いです。
romaji: mukashi no sakuhin desuga, neemu nashi de sukihoudai yatteshimattanode muda ni nagai desu.
meaning: This is an early work, I did it freely without storyboarding so it's unreasonably long.

japanese: 君が次に分かることは君が新聞に載るってことだ。
romaji: kun ga tsuginiwaka rukotoha kun ga shinbun ni noru ttekotoda.
meaning: Next thing you know, you'll be in the papers.

japanese: 君が次に分かることは君が新聞に載るってことだ。
romaji: kun ga tsuginiwaka rukotoha kun ga shinbun ni noru ttekotoda.
meaning: Next thing you know, you'll be in the papers.

japanese: エルサレムは、メッカ・メディナに次ぐイスラム教第3の聖地である。
romaji: erusaremu ha, mekka・medina ni tsugu isuramu kyoudai 3 no seichi dearu.
meaning: Jerusalem is the third holy city in Islam, following Mecca and Medina.

japanese: 車の事故に関する現行の法は手直しが必要である。
romaji: kuruma no jiko ni kansu ru genkou no hou wa tenaoshi ga hitsuyou dearu.
meaning: The existing law concerning car accidents requires amending.

japanese: 突然の熊の出現に子供たちは死んだふりをした。
romaji: totsuzen no kuma no shutsugen ni kodomo tachiha shin dafuriwoshita.
meaning: At the sudden appearance of a bear, the kids made believe they were dead.

japanese: 彼女の旧姓はブラウンだ。
romaji: kanojo no kyuusei wa buraun da.
meaning: She was a Brown before her marriage.

japanese: 私の家は旧家です。
romaji: watashi no ie wa kyuuka desu.
meaning: My family is an old one.

japanese: お祖母さんの昔話は耳にたこができるほど聞かされた。
romaji: o sobo sanno mukashibanashi wa mimi nitakogadekiruhodo kika sareta.
meaning: I've heard my grandma's stories so often that I'm heartily sick of them.

japanese: 容姿端麗、頭脳明晰、運動神経抜群、家は金持ちで、ついでに学生会の副会長をしてたりもする、いわゆるパーフェクトな奴だ。
romaji: youshitanrei, zunoumeiseki, undoushinkeibatsugun, ie wa kanemochi de, tsuideni gakuseikai no fukukaichou woshitetarimosuru, iwayuru paafekuto na yatsu da.
meaning: Looks, brains, reflexes, rich family and, for good measure, vice president of the student committee - in other words he's 'perfect'.

japanese: 次回につづく、ということで、どうかお付き合いのほど、平にお願いいたします。
romaji: jikai nitsuzuku, toiukotode, doukao tsukiai nohodo, taira nio negai itashimasu.
meaning: To be continued next time, and thus I most humbly request your attendance then.

japanese: 夕闇が次第に深まっていった。
romaji: yuuyami ga shidai ni fukama tteitta.
meaning: The twilight merged into darkness.

japanese: これは席次表。
romaji: kore wa sekijihyou.
meaning: This is seating plan (e.g. banquet), seating chart.

japanese: 社長は現実的なタイプの人だ。
romaji: shachou wa genjitsuteki na taipu no nin da.
meaning: The president is a down-to-earth kind of man.

japanese: 小中学生なんて、まだまだ善悪の見分けも、現実と仮想の見分けもつかない。
romaji: shouchuugakusei nante, madamada zen'aku no miwake mo, genjitsu to kasou no miwake motsukanai.
meaning: Elementary and primary school children don't yet know good from evil or reality from fiction.

japanese: 惰性に身を任せているがために今のような現在があるんですね。
romaji: dasei ni miwomakase teirugatameni ima noyouna genzai gaarundesune.
meaning: I've ended up in my present state from having indulged myself.

japanese: 母系の祖母はその旧式のドレスを着ることに固執する。
romaji: bokei no sobo hasono kyuushiki no doresu o kiru kotoni koshitsu suru.
meaning: My maternal grandmother persists in wearing that old-fashioned dress.

japanese: 彼は休暇を利用してニューヨークに旅行に行く途中、旧友の所にちょっと立ち寄った。
romaji: karehakyuuka o riyou shite nyuuyooku ni ryokou ni ikutochuu, kyuuyuu no tokoro nichotto tachiyotsu ta.
meaning: He dropped in on some old friends during his vacation trip to New York.

japanese: これは旧正月。
romaji: kore wa kyuushougatsu.
meaning: This is lunisolar New Year, Chinese New Year, Vietnamese Tet.

japanese: 輸出は３００億ドル増加した。
romaji: yushutsu wa 3 0 0 oku doru zouka shita.
meaning: The exports increased by 30 billion dollars.

japanese: 彼は糖尿病のどんな兆しにも注意していた。
romaji: karehatounyoubyou nodonna kizashi nimo chuui shiteita.
meaning: He was watchful for any sign of diabetes.

japanese: これは兆す。
romaji: kore wa kizasu.
meaning: This is to show signs, to have symptoms, to give indications (of), to bud, to germinate, to sprout.

japanese: 彼は糖尿病のどんな兆しにも注意していた。
romaji: karehatounyoubyou nodonna kizashi nimo chuui shiteita.
meaning: He was watchful for any sign of diabetes.

japanese: 余生は自分の理想の追求に費やしたい。
romaji: yosei wa jibun no risou no tsuikyuu ni tsuiyashi tai.
meaning: I want to spend rest of the life pursuing my ideals.

japanese: これは費える。
romaji: kore wa tsuieru.
meaning: This is to use up (one's savings), to be wasted (time, effort, etc.), to fall apart, to become useless, to be wiped out (in battle), to fall apart (one's body or health).

japanese: 彼女は本に収入の大部分を費やす。
romaji: kanojo wa hon ni shuunyuu no daibubun o tsuiyasu.
meaning: She spends most of her income on books.

japanese: 彼は、足し算が速い。
romaji: kareha, tashizan ga hayai.
meaning: He is quick at addition.

japanese: バイトで学費を稼ぎながら大学に通ってる。まあ苦学生ってとこかな。
romaji: baito de gakuhi o kasegi nagara daigaku ni tootte ru. maa kugakuitsu tetokokana.
meaning: I pay my university fees to go to university by part-time work. Well, I'm a 'working student' I suppose.

japanese: 消費者の米離れや国際市場解放が原因とされる米価の下落が原因だ。
romaji: shouhisha no komehanare ya kokusaishijoukaihou ga gen'in tosareru beika no geraku ga gen'in da.
meaning: It is the drop in the rice pricing (blamed on consumers' loss of interest in rice and the freeing up of the international market) that is the cause.

japanese: 参加のための会費は不要です。
romaji: sanka notameno kaihi wa fuyou desu.
meaning: There's no membership fee for joining.

japanese: 彼女は収入の大部分を食費に使う。
romaji: kanojo wa shuunyuu no daibubun o shokuhi ni tsukau.
meaning: She spends a major part of her income on food.

japanese: 彼は簡単な算数すらできなかった。
romaji: karehakantan na sansuu suradekinakatta.
meaning: He couldn't do even simple arithmetic.

japanese: 彼は暗算をするほど頭が良くない。
romaji: karehaanzan wosuruhodo atama ga yoku nai.
meaning: He doesn't have enough brains to do sums in his head.

japanese: 彼の怠惰は将来に対する悪い前兆だった。
romaji: kanotaida wa shourai ni taisuruwaruizenchou datta.
meaning: His laziness boded ill for the future.

japanese: 歯医者で歯についたたばこのヤニを取ってもらうと、費用はどれくらいかかるでしょう？
romaji: haisha de wa nitsuitatabakono yani o totsu temorauto, hiyou hadorekuraikakarudeshou ？
meaning: About how much does it cost to have a dentist remove cigarette tar from your teeth?

japanese: 予算を検討し、コストを削減することにした。
romaji: yosan o kentoushi, kosuto o sakugen surukotonishita.
meaning: I reviewed the budget, and decided to cut costs.

japanese: この式によって電場を計算してやると、結果は次のようになる。
romaji: kono shiki niyotte denba o keisan shiteyaruto, kekka wa tsugino youninaru.
meaning: If you calculate the electric field using this equation, the result comes out like the following.

japanese: 彼女は私のお供をするように仕向けられた。
romaji: kanojo wa watashi noo tomo wosuruyouni shimuke kerareta.
meaning: She was tempted to come with me.

japanese: 彼女は私のお供をするように仕向けられた。
romaji: kanojo wa watashi noo tomo wosuruyouni shimuke kerareta.
meaning: She was tempted to come with me.

japanese: これは供える。
romaji: kore wa sonaeru.
meaning: This is to offer, to sacrifice, to dedicate.

japanese: 法律はすべての市民に税を払うように義務づけている。
romaji: houritsu hasubeteno shimin ni zei o harau youni gimu zuketeiru.
meaning: The laws oblige all citizens to pay taxes.

japanese: これは試供品。
romaji: kore wa shikyouhin.
meaning: This is specimen, sample.

japanese: 安価な簡易住宅を提供します。
romaji: anka na kan'ijuutaku o teikyou shimasu.
meaning: We offer low-cost prefabricated houses.

japanese: 宝石の関税を払った。
romaji: houseki no kanzei o haratsu ta.
meaning: We paid customs on jewels.

japanese: 犯人は窃盗を自供した。
romaji: hannin wa settou o jikyou shita.
meaning: The criminal confessed to theft.

japanese: 大部分の日本人が増税に反対した。
romaji: daibubun no nihonjin ga zouzei ni hantai shita.
meaning: Most Japanese opposed a tax increase.

japanese: 「それは糖分を供給してもっと働けと暗に……？」「はい？」「いや、ちょとやさぐれてるだけ。ごめん」
romaji: ( soreha toubun o kyoukyuu shitemotto hatarake to anni … … ？) ( hai ？) ( iya, chotoyasagureterudake. gomen)
meaning: "Is that implying that I go get some sugar in me and then work more?" "Er?" "No, sorry. I'm just sulking a bit."

japanese: 税金を払ったら実生活の始まりだ。
romaji: zeikin o haratsu tara jisseikatsu no hajimari da.
meaning: Life begins when you pay taxes.

japanese: 日本では、ほとんどの物やサービスに５％の消費税がかけられる。
romaji: nippon deha, hotondono mono ya saabisu ni 5 % no shouhizei gakakerareru.
meaning: A 5% consumption tax is levied on most goods and services in Japan.

japanese: 彼らは減税は自分たちの功績だと主張した。
romaji: karera wa genzei wa jibuntachi no kouseki dato shuchou shita.
meaning: They took credit for the tax cut.

japanese: 税関を通り抜けると、私は好きなところへどこへでも自由に行くことができた。
romaji: zeikan o tourinuke ruto, watashi wa suki natokorohedokohedemo jiyuu ni iku kotogadekita.
meaning: After getting through customs, I was free to go wherever I wanted.

japanese: 万事うまくいくように私が気をつけます。
romaji: banji umakuikuyouni watashi ga kiwo tsukemasu.
meaning: I will see that all goes well.

japanese: ニジェールでは50万人もの子供たちが未だ栄養失調に直面している。
romaji: nijieeru deha 50 bannin mono kodomo tachiga imadaeiyoushitchou ni chokumen shiteiru.
meaning: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.

japanese: 年明けに子供が産まれる予定です♪
romaji: toshiake ni kodomo ga uma reru yotei desu ♪
meaning: I'm expecting a baby in the new year!

japanese: 年明けに子供が産まれる予定です♪
romaji: toshiake ni kodomo ga uma reru yotei desu ♪
meaning: I'm expecting a baby in the new year!

japanese: 油断なく注意さえしておれば好機はおのずからうまれる。
romaji: yudan naku chuui saeshiteoreba kouki haonozukaraumareru.
meaning: Plenty of opportunities will present themselves, if only you are awake to them.

japanese: なんか分からないが、一筋縄じゃいきそうにないってことだな。ううむ。
romaji: nanka waka ranaiga, hitosujinawa jaikisouninaittekotodana. uumu.
meaning: I don't quite follow, but it looks like it will prove tricky. Ergh.

japanese: 米国にノウと言えるのか？
romaji: beikoku ni nou to ie runoka ？
meaning: Can we say "No" to America?

japanese: スーパーボウルを見るために会社を休んでいた事もありました。
romaji: suupaabouru o miru tameni kaisha o yasun deita koto moarimashita.
meaning: I've sometimes taken time off work to watch the Super Bowl.

japanese: 竜也氏は穀類を商っている。
romaji: tatsuyashi wa kokurui o akinatsu teiru.
meaning: Mr Tatuya deals in grain.

japanese: あの商人は絹織物を商う。
romaji: ano shounin wa kinuorimono o akinau.
meaning: The merchant deals in silk goods.

japanese: これは産声。
romaji: kore wa ubugoe.
meaning: This is baby's first cry.

japanese: これは生産者。
romaji: kore wa seisansha.
meaning: This is manufacturer, producer.

japanese: 猛台風が財産に被害を与えた。
romaji: takeshitaifuu ga zaisan ni higai o atae ta.
meaning: A severe typhoon has done much damage to property.

japanese: 僕は決して農業が嫌いな訳じゃない。
romaji: bokuhakesshitenougyou ga kirai na wake janai.
meaning: By no means do I dislike farming.

japanese: 当時の農家の暴利はすさまじかった。
romaji: touji no nouka no bouri hasusamajikatta.
meaning: The bloated profits of farmers at the time were something again.

japanese: 中心部にあるので商店やオフィスに行くのに便利です。
romaji: chuushinbu niarunode shouten ya ofisu ni iku noni benri desu.
meaning: The central location gives easy access to stores and offices.

japanese: 彼らは、産業を勉強します。
romaji: karera ha, sangyou o benkyou shimasu.
meaning: They study industry.

japanese: 多くの女性がより高い教養とキャリアを追求し、それ故に結婚と出産を先延ばしにしている。
romaji: ooku no josei gayori takaikyouyou to kyaria o tsuikyuu shi, sore yuenikekkon to shussan o sakinoba shinishiteiru.
meaning: Many women pursue higher education and careers, thus delaying marriage and childbirth.

japanese: 事業を継続しながら、事業が依拠している不動産を切り売りしていくことなど非現実的なのだ。
romaji: jigyou o keizoku shinagara, jigyou ga ikyo shiteiru fudousan o kiriuri shiteikukotonado higenjitsuteki nanoda.
meaning: It's ludicrous to continue business operations while selling off bit by bit the land on which your business depends.

japanese: これは農学部。
romaji: kore wa nougakubu.
meaning: This is department of agriculture.

japanese: やりがいはあるけれどもリスクと労働時間を考えると・・・、ものすごく損な商売なのかもしれませんね。
romaji: yarigaihaarukeredomo risuku to roudoujikan o kangae ruto ・・・, monosugoku sokonashoubai nanokamoshiremasenne.
meaning: It's a job worth doing, but if I think about the working hours and the risk ... I could be onto a real losing proposition here.

japanese: 彼は商業に従事している。
romaji: karehashougyou ni juuji shiteiru.
meaning: He is in business.

japanese: 「エグゼンプション」の議論を機に働き方を見直そう。
romaji: ( eguzenpushon) no giron o kinihatarakihouwominaoso u.
meaning: Let's take advantage of the 'exemption' controversy to reconsider the way we work.

japanese: こんなデカイのがチャリの荷台に乗るわけないだろ。
romaji: konna dekai noga chari no nidai ni noru wakenaidaro.
meaning: There's no way one that big is going to go on a bike's luggage rest.

japanese: 私の命が危ないと言ってるわけですか？
romaji: watashi no inochi ga abunai to itte ruwakedesuka ？
meaning: Are you saying my life is in danger?

japanese: 私の命が危ないと言ってるわけですか？
romaji: watashi no inochi ga abunai to itte ruwakedesuka ？
meaning: Are you saying my life is in danger?

japanese: 彼は危ういところで死なずにすんだ。
romaji: karehaayaui tokorode shina zunisunda.
meaning: He barely missed being killed.

japanese: 私は彼の成功を危ぶむ。
romaji: watashi wa kanoseikou o ayabu mu.
meaning: I am doubtful of his success.

japanese: 彼らは険しい北面を登った。

romaji: ryoushin hasateoki, daremo sono yougisha o bengo shinaidearou.
meaning: Apart from his parents, nobody would defend the suspect.

japanese: 彼女には一抹の罪悪感があった。
romaji: kanojo niha ichimatsu no zaiakukan gaatta.
meaning: She had a vague feeling of guilt.

japanese: その運河は150,000重量トンの大きさの船を収容できる。
romaji: sono unga wa 150, 000 juuryou ton no ookisa no fune o shuuyou dekiru.
meaning: The canal can accommodate ships as large as 150,000 dead weight tons.

japanese: 飛行機は外国旅行を容易にした。
romaji: hikouki wa gaikokuryokou o youini shita.
meaning: Airplanes have made it easy to travel abroad.

japanese: これは質疑。
romaji: kore wa shitsugi.
meaning: This is question, interpellation.

japanese: ああ、オレも実際、こうして目の当たりにするまでは半信半疑だったが・・・。
romaji: aa, ore mo jissai, koushite menoatari nisurumadeha hanshinhangi dattaga ・・・.
meaning: Yes, truthfully, until it was right in front of me like this, I half-doubted it ...

japanese: 両親がくだらないことで言い争っていて、とてもいらいらするよ。
romaji: ryoushin gakudaranaikotode iiarasotsu teite, totemoirairasuruyo.
meaning: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!

japanese: 試合は終始一点を争うシーソーゲームだった。
romaji: shiai wa shuushiitten o arasou shiisoogeemu datta.
meaning: The game was one point back and forth the whole game.

japanese: これは敗れる。
romaji: kore wa yabureru.
meaning: This is to be defeated, to be beaten, to be unsuccessful, to lose.

japanese: 予想されたことだが、彼らはコンテストに敗れた。
romaji: yosou saretakotodaga, karera wa kontesuto ni yabure ta.
meaning: As was expected, they lost the contest.

japanese: 革命政府は、民衆から兵をつのって防戦するとともに、共和政治を確立して、捕らえていたルイ１６世を処刑しました。
romaji: kakumeiseifu ha, minshuu kara hei wotsunotte bousen surutotomoni, kyouwaseiji o kakuritsu shite, tora eteita rui 1 6 yo o shokei shimashita.
meaning: The revolutionary government, while raising troops from the masses and fighting a defensive battle, established a republic and executed Louis XVI.

japanese: アメリカは発表するたびに、イラク軍のゲリラ抵抗を「テロ」と呼んでおります。
romaji: amerika wa happyou surutabini, iraku gun no gerira teikou o ( tero) to yon deorimasu.
meaning: In reports in America, guerrilla resistance by the Iraq military is called terrorism.

japanese: １００万人の人々がその戦争で命を落とした。
romaji: 1 0 0 bannin no hitobito gasono sensou de inochi o oto shita.
meaning: One million people lost their lives in the war.

japanese: 勝敗は問題ではない。
romaji: shouhai wa mondai dehanai.
meaning: It doesn't matter whether you win or not.

japanese: これは大敗。
romaji: kore wa taihai.
meaning: This is crushing defeat.

japanese: 模擬試験に何回も失敗して、実際に受けてみたら思わぬ結果が出た。
romaji: mogishiken ni nankai mo shippai shite, jissainiuke temitara omowa nu kekka ga deta.
meaning: Having failed my mock examinations any number of times, when I actually tried taking it the result was nothing I'd imagined.

japanese: これは不敗。
romaji: kore wa fuhai.
meaning: This is invincibility.

japanese: 日本は兵器にあまりお金を使うべきではない。
romaji: nippon wa heiki niamario kin o tsukau bekidehanai.
meaning: Japan should not spend much money on weapons.

japanese: 彼らは言い争いをした。
romaji: karera wa iiarasoi woshita.
meaning: They quarreled.

japanese: これは敗退。
romaji: kore wa haitai.
meaning: This is being defeated, being eliminated (from competition).

japanese: これは一軍。
romaji: kore wa ichigun.
meaning: This is one army, whole army, (sports) first string players.

japanese: これは兵糧。
romaji: kore wa hyourou.
meaning: This is (army) provisions, food.

japanese: 私のパソコンは何かの役に立つはずだ。
romaji: watashi no pasokon wa nanika no yakunitatsu hazuda.
meaning: My computer has got to be useful for something.

japanese: これは臣。
romaji: kore wa shinjin.
meaning: This is retainer, subject.

japanese: 君は役所に自分で出頭する事が必要なのだ。
romaji: kun wa yakusho ni jibun de shuttou suru koto ga hitsuyou nanoda.
meaning: It is essential that you present yourself at the office.

japanese: 睡眠は重要であるにもかかわらず、その役割は謎である。
romaji: suimin wa juuyou dearunimokakawarazu, sono yakuwari wa nazo dearu.
meaning: Despite the importance of sleep, its purpose is a mystery.

japanese: その映画の配役が決まった。
romaji: sono eiga no haiyaku ga kima tta.
meaning: They have cast the movie.

japanese: 彼は兵役を免除されている。
romaji: karehaheieki o menjo sareteiru.
meaning: He is exempt from the military service.

japanese: 彼は大臣を辞めた。
romaji: karehadaijin o yame ta.
meaning: He resigned from the Cabinet.

japanese: 矛盾する報告を受けて、その役員は自分の立場を考え直した。
romaji: mujun suru houkoku o uke te, sono yakuin wa jibun no tachiba o kangaenaoshi ta.
meaning: Conflicting reports prompted the director to reconsider her position.

japanese: これは大役。
romaji: kore wa taiyaku.
meaning: This is important task, important role, great duty, important mission, major part (e.g. in a movie).

japanese: これは使役形。
romaji: kore wa shiekikei.
meaning: This is causative form.

japanese: これは臣下。
romaji: kore wa shinka.
meaning: This is retainer.
